issue:624.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

DigitalMate 的工具调用与 MCP 链路存在多处**每次都发生的固定开销**：会话启动、文件交付、工具描述下发这几个环节都有可避免的重复工作。这些开销与用户任务无关，属于「不管做什么都要付的成本」，因此对每一轮对话、每一个任务都在累加。

2026-11-05 的对照实验（同一批任务，两次运行）测到的现象：

- 两项合成文件局部修改任务中，工具说明与目录提示导致模型**默认全量读取文件**（一次读回 88,410 字节 / 2000 行，而任务目标并不在该段落），并伴随路径试错与恢复调用；
- 累计输入 token 在两个完整配对组中由 **1,582,216 增至 1,878,641（+18.7%）**；主模型调用次数 52→46（次数下降但单次输入变大）。

需要说明的是：这 18.7% 只覆盖该批任务的路径/目录提示类修复，**不能**外推为通用提速（另补的一对账单为 +0.38%，未复现大范围默认读取，不足以推翻也不足以加强前面结论）。同一轮也确认没有 MCP 协议调用，因此本文不作为 MCP 性能收益证据。

针对上述固定开销，已提交 6 个独立修复 PR（标题均为 `perf(...)`，目标 main）：

| 修复 | PR | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 同路径更新文件交付：按内容版本去重，避免每次重发未变文件 | [#574](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/574) | 已合并 |
| WorkSwarm 工具包公开导出按需解析，导入叶子不再初始化无关 SDK | [#580](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/580) | 待合并 |
| 文件交付校验不再初始化 SDK（helper 叶子加载、导入优先级） | [#576](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/576) | 已合并 |
| 工具进程绑定到声明式 Python 环境，避免继承错误 PATH | [#578](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/578) | 待合并 |
| agent-core 文件工具说明与实际执行契约对齐（相对路径、读前保护） | [#579](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/579) | 待合并 |
| 无项目场景目录提示明确当前工作目录 cwd，避免模型自行拼接任务根 | [#582](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/582) | 待合并 |

本 issue 用于统一跟踪这组性能修复的背景、边界与后续验收口径，避免各 PR 各自描述导致口径不一致。

### Design Ideas

按「消除固定开销」而非「换更快实现」的思路，分为四类：

1. **不重复做已经做过的事**：#574 记录每个会话/路径/目标集合最后成功交付的内容版本，内容未变则复用原结论，不再重新发送同一文件。#580 让工具包的公开导出在真正被访问时才解析，导入一个叶子模块不再牵连初始化整个 Agent SDK。

2. **不做与本次调用无关的初始化**：#576 让文件交付校验走轻量路径，不为了校验而拉起 SDK；#578 在导入任何 WorkSwarm 模块**之前**把工具命令绑定到声明的 Python 环境，避免子进程继承到错误的解释器后才发现。

3. **让模型少走弯路（减少无效往返）**：#579 让文件工具的说明与执行器实际强制的行为一致（相对路径基准、edit 前需先部分读、覆盖写前需完整读），模型不再靠试错发现规则；#582 让无项目场景的目录提示先给出权威 cwd，再说任务组织根目录，模型不必自己拼接路径。

4. **明确不采用的方案**：
   - 不通过放宽校验来换速度。所有修复都保持原有 fail-closed 行为（例如不可读取文件仍会被排除并如实上报，只是措辞与另一分支统一）；
   - 不引入新缓存层。当前所有「复用」都以已有事实为依据（内容哈希、显式配置），没有新增跨会话状态；
   - 保留 #574 中团队↔项目同名冲突的既有覆盖保护，不改为覆盖用户文件。

### Involved Public APIs

对外协议与公共接口**无变更**，均为内部实现与文案调整：

- #574/#576：交付结果的 JSON 结构不变；仅调整「未发送文件」的提示措辞，使部分交付与全部跳过两个分支一致（不可读取的文件不再被描述为「不存在」）。
- #580：`jiuwenswarm.agents.harness.common.tools` 的公开符号名、可选依赖回退行为保持不变，仅改变解析时机；调用方无感知。
- #578：新增环境变量 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_TOOL_PYTHON`（可选，未设置时行为与之前完全一致）；设置后要求为可执行文件的绝对路径，否则启动即失败并给出明确错误。
- #579：仅 agent-core 工具描述文本；执行器的校验与拒绝逻辑不变。
- #582：仅系统提示中的目录说明文本；路径解析、权限与文件系统保护不变。

来源完整性：以上改动涉及 vendored 源码（WorkSwarm / agent-core）时，同步更新了 `harness/UPSTREAM.json` 的 `import_overrides[].git_blob` 与 `imported_git_tree`，`python harness/verify_sources.py` 通过。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- **与 #577（重复「继续」导致 token 滚雪球）的关系**：互补但不同层。#577 处理的是「任务已完成仍全量重生成」的语义问题；本组处理的是「单次调用本身的固定开销」。两者可叠加，不重叠。
- **与 #223（TTFT 约 5s、含工具调用超 20s）的关系**：本组缩短的是工具链路的准备与无效往返，不改变模型推理与网络时延，因此**不能**用来解释或承诺 TTFT 改善。
- **与 #383 / #575（额度与余额）的关系**：固定开销下降会减少同任务的累计输入 token，间接影响配额消耗；但本组未做计费侧验证。
- **与 CI 门禁的关系**：本组未修改任何 workflow、门禁脚本、skip 配置或 Runner 配置。

### Test Design and Test Plan

已完成的验证（每个 PR 独立分支内）：

1. **来源完整性**：`python -B harness/verify_sources.py`，6 个 PR 均通过，重算后的 `imported_git_tree` 一致。
2. **单元与运行环境测试**：`harness/tests` 与相关模块套件在隔离 venv（Python 3.12/3.13）中运行通过；#574 为文件交付 19 项、#580 工具导出 4 项、#576 文件校验 8 项、#578 工具环境 6 项、#579 契约 6 项、#582 目录提示 4 项（含 cn/en 双语与 4 个本地渠道）。
3. **缺陷回归**：解冲突过程中发现并修复两处真实缺陷——#574 部分交付分支的错误措辞（新增断言，且在保留旧措辞的对照 worktree 上确认该断言会失败，证明确有区分度）；#582 在 main 新增的提示前缀测试与新分段结构下的适配。
4. **合并健康度**：6 个 PR 均已与最新 main 合并验证，`git merge-tree` 全部干净。

后续验收建议（尚未执行，需另行授权）：

1. **固定开销基线**：对同一组任务比较修复前后「工具准备阶段耗时」与「首次工具调用前的往返次数」，而非只看总耗时（总耗时受模型平台波动影响，不能作为代码效果证据）。
2. **重复交付抑制**：同一会话内重复请求未变更文件 N 次，断言实际传输次数为 1 且模型侧收到的结论一致。
3. **导入副作用**：仅导入 `tools` 叶子模块，断言未初始化无关 SDK 模块（可用 `sys.modules` 快照断言）。
4. **路径试错次数**：在无项目场景执行相对路径任务，断言路径错误与恢复调用次数为 0。
5. **不回归**：不可读取/特殊文件仍不得阻塞同批其余文件交付；授权失败后仍必须撤销已暂存资产并可重试。

### Additional Information

- 验证证据随各 PR 保存在 `docs/developer_guide/evidence/tool-mcp-fixes-2026-11-05/<topic>/` 下（含验证报表图），便于合并后在 Developer Guide 中追溯。
- 已知环境限制（非缺陷）：#574 的 `test_failed_authorized_delivery_revokes_assets_and_can_retry` 在 Windows 上于**未修改的原始 head** 同样失败，根因是清理资产时文件句柄未释放导致的 `OSError` 被吞掉，属既有 Windows 限制，不计为本组回归。
- 本组修复不改变模型选择、不调整提示中的任务内容，也不引入新的性能模型实验；上文引用的 +18.7% 仅用于说明动机与问题存在，不作为本组修复已达成该幅度收益的声明。

issue:626.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Track E1 rendering workflow hardening separately from the E1-E3 umbrella issue #571. The four existing cases are DM-WF-MATH-01, DM-WF-STRUCTURED-01, DM-WF-CHROME-01 and DM-WF-QUOTE-01. Implementation: #625.

### Design Ideas

Use fixed Markdown fixtures and authenticated, read-only inspection of the latest completed task in the isolated test room. Compare actual response content with fixtureEquals, assert UI facts within assistant reply containers, verify scroll movement, and bind quote summaries to their source and user bubble. Preserve case versions, screenshots, UI evidence and source hashes. Provide English documentation for running and extending E1 cases.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Run all four E1 cases on the signed-in emulator with their assertions enabled. Check fixture comparison against changed content, reply scoping against matching user input, missing evidence handling and version fingerprints. Run the focused Node suites and validate all workflow definitions.

Recorded device run e1-571-simple-r3 completed all four cases with 18 passing assertions. The focused Node suites passed 107 tests, and workflow validation passed 23 definitions. Publish the device report and E1 case guide with #625.

### 🚀 Background Description

Track E2 interaction-control hardening for BACK-01, BACK-02, QUOTE-02 and QUEUE-02, following E1 (#626, PR #625) and the E1-E3 umbrella issue #571. User actions should affect the intended object once and preserve drafts and interaction bindings.

issue:643.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

支持在同一台PC上并行启动、管理多个独立的鸿蒙模拟器，并将不同测试任务分配到不同模拟器执行，提高设备测试吞吐量，减少CI排队时间。

目前已在本地Windows PC验证两台模拟器同时启动，以及同一份Hypium设备测试包在两台模拟器上并发执行。需要将这一操作固化为仓库可复用的脚本、配置和测试指导，而非依赖人工操作。

### Design Ideas

#### 功能范围

- 支持配置模拟器数量、实例名称、HDC端口、系统镜像及资源参数；首批以Windows PC双实例为验收基线，后续根据资源容量扩展。
- 每个实例使用独立的数据目录和设备标识。已存在实例可复用，不默认删除、重建或清空数据。
- 提供启动、连接、健康检查与停止入口，区分启动器存活、端口监听、HDC连接及系统启动完成，避免仅凭Running状态判断成功。
- 测试执行显式绑定目标设备，所有安装、启动、测试与日志命令传递设备标识，不自动选择第一台设备。
- 同一设备使用独占锁，不同设备可并行；支持超时、失败记录及可控恢复。禁止任务全局重启HDC或结束其他任务的模拟器。
- 测试日志、结果及临时目录按任务和设备隔离，汇总通过、失败、错误、忽略、超时及耗时，保留首次失败和重试证据。
- 首先支持构建一次测试包、在多个模拟器上并行执行；如支持多构建任务并发，须使用独立工作目录并单独验证，不能在同一构建目录并发运行Hvigor。
- 提供对接GitHub Actions多个执行槽的配置说明。增加runner数量与增加模拟器数量是两个独立环节。

#### 测试入口边界

现有 `scripts/ci/hypium-ut.ps1` 使用 `testType=unit` 在PC本地运行，并不占用模拟器。设备并行执行应使用明确的设备测试入口；不得把两份本地UT运行声称为双模拟器测试。

设备入口 `digitalmate/entry/src/ohosTest/ets/test/List.test.ets` 包含共享UT及少量设备专用用例。报告中应明确执行范围，支持完整套件重复执行或明确划分的分片，不混淆两种结果。

### Involved Public APIs

不涉及面向APP用户的公共API变化。新增或调整的模拟器管理、设备选择、并发数和输出目录等脚本参数，需在实现中明确并保持现有单设备入口兼容。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

涉及DevEco模拟器与HDC、Hypium设备测试、CI调度、设备锁、构建与产物管理、测试报告及开发文档。不同测试任务还应隔离测试账号、云端会话和本地服务端口，避免设备隔离后仍产生业务状态串扰。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- [ ] 同一PC可同时启动至少两个独立模拟器；分别验证HDC连接、系统启动完成及基础命令响应。
- [ ] 在两个目标设备上并发执行Hypium设备测试，保存各自日志及结构化结果；执行时间存在重叠。
- [ ] 明确统计用例数量、通过、失败、错误、忽略及耗时；必须读取Hypium汇总和结束状态，缺少结果或零用例不得判为通过。
- [ ] 验证目标选择正确，不出现A任务安装或操作B设备的情况。
- [ ] 验证锁屏、启动超时、端口冲突、设备断连及测试失败有清晰诊断；失败结果保留，重试不覆盖首次证据。
- [ ] 中止或重启一个实例，不影响另一个实例及其测试；同一设备的冲突任务正确等待或拒绝。
- [ ] 验证单设备运行仍可用，并记录双设备执行的资源峰值、整轮耗时和失败率；不预设线性性能提升。
- [ ] 完成可复现的Windows配置、许可协议确认、启动、并发执行、结果读取及故障处理文档。

### Additional Information

已有本地验证（2026-11-05）：

| 项目 | 模拟器A | 模拟器B |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 实例 | DigitalMatePhone | DigitalMatePhoneB |
| 设备标识 | 127.0.0.1:10001 | 127.0.0.1:10002 |
| 系统 | HarmonyOS 7.0.0 / API 26 / x86_64 | HarmonyOS 7.0.0 / API 26 / x86_64 |
| Hypium结果 | 2307通过，0失败，0错误 | 2307通过，0失败，0错误 |
| Hypium报告耗时 | 20.313秒 | 19.851秒 |

上述验证采用一次构建、两台设备并发执行完整设备入口；首次运行A因锁屏失败，解锁后两台并发重跑通过。它不证明两个独立编译任务已能并发运行，也不保证其他硬件具有相同表现。

操作指南已准备在个人开发分支 `Hypium_parallel` 的本地目录 `docs/contributing/ci/` 下，尚未提交或推送；实现时需补充可访问的文档和执行证据链接。责任人与完成时间待安排。

## 上下文
手机端 DigitalMate。「发现」负一屏瀑布流体验可用（新闻/视频卡片、底部提示「试试说：多给我推荐点足球内容」）。产品侧需确认：当前流是否已由个人记忆驱动。报告人判断「应该还和个人记忆没关系」——经对照代码后记录为观察/条目标清，非立刻修 bug。

## 测试环境
- **版本（暂无正式版本号/分支）：** 按报告时间记为 `build≈2026-10-20`（Asia/Shanghai）
- 截图状态栏时间：约 08:13
- 设备型号 / 正式 App 版本号：暂无，待补
- 客户端：DigitalMate 手机端（Orbit phone client）
- 路径：底栏「发现」

## 原图

![发现负一屏](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg?raw=true)

证据分支：`bot/issue-evidence` · [文件](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/bot/issue-evidence/issue-evidence/2026-10-20-discovery-vs-memory.jpg)

## 结果
- **实际（体感）：** 发现流为通用信源内容（如医保、时政视频、妈祖等），未见明显由对话个人记忆个性化的证据；更像冷启/探索 + 发现页自有偏好（composer/标签）。
- **代码对照（现状，非实现任务）：**
  - 存在预留 `DiscoveryMemoryProjection`（`entry/.../waterfall/DiscoveryMemoryProjection*.ets`）：可把长期记忆投影为发现偏好信号。
  - 重建门槛：`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD = 8`，且默认等待约 7 天（`DISCOVERY_MEMORY_PROJECTION_WAIT_MS`）——不是装上即读个人记忆。
  - 发现 PES 实验：P（profile）初始为空，经发现 composer/标签填充；新账号先走 E（探索）冷启。与对话「个人记忆」不是同一条即时通路。
- **期望（条目标清）：** 产品文档/验收写明：发现负一屏当前 **不依赖** 个人记忆即可用；若要「记忆 → 发现」接通，另开实现 issue，并写清门槛与验收。

## 验收
- [ ] README / 能力说明写清：发现 ≠ 已接个人记忆（或写明接通条件）
- [ ] 若做接通：有独立验收（记忆事实变更后发现偏好可见、可关、可解释）
- [ ] 本观察不阻塞发现负一屏作为独立体验继续迭代

### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文注明区别）。
- [x] 已提供群内原始反馈与截图。
- [x] 已按群公告的「现象 / 预期 / 场景」格式整理（原始反馈即为三段式）。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：「实时活动」列表里能看到多条标记为「已完成」的任务记录，但清理时却提示没有可清理的内容，这些记录无法删除。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-05 21:22，胡犇，附截图）：

> 现象：在"实时活动"列表中可以看到多条标记为"已完成"的任务记录，但清理聊天记录后点击清理，界面弹出"没有可清理的已完成任务"的提示，这些已完成的记录无法被清理。
> 预期：清理聊天记录后，已完成的记录应能被正常清理；只要列表中存在可清理的已完成任务，就不应提示"没有可清理的已完成任务"。
> 场景：v0.1.7 版本

截图（BeeBou → 实时活动 → 最近活动）可见至少 4 条「已完成」记录，其中两条带「已完成 · DONE: '/data/state/home/Documents...'」，另两条为「已完成 · Guava」；底部 Toast 同时显示「没有可清理的已完成任务」。

复现步骤：
1. 进入 BeeBou → 实时活动，确认「最近活动」中存在多条状态为「已完成」的记录。
2. 清理聊天记录。
3. 在实时活动页触发清理。

实际结果：弹出「没有可清理的已完成任务」，列表中的已完成记录一条都没有被删除。
预期结果：
- 只要列表中存在「已完成」记录，清理动作就应该把它们清掉，并给出「已清理 N 条」的反馈。
- 清理聊天记录不应影响实时活动的清理判定（两者是不同数据源，判定逻辑不应互相污染）。
- 若某些记录因状态机原因不可清理（例如已停止/失败态），也不应把「已完成」的算作不可清理，且提示应说明「哪些不可清理、为什么」。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou 手机端
- 版本：v0.1.7（报告人标注）
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群，2026-11-05 21:22（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 同一张截图里还能看到两个相关现象，建议一并排查（本次未单独建单，因为报告人只描述了清理问题）：
  1. 「最近活动」的标题直接显示原始英文指令片段（如 `If there is anything that doesn't ...`），没有做本地化/摘要；
  2. 已完成记录的副标题里出现云侧路径 `DONE: '/data/state/home/Documents...'`，与 #485（回答正文暴露云侧沙箱路径）属于同一类信息泄漏，只是这里出现在活动列表。
- 与 #460（定时提醒无系统推送）、#456（定时提醒未出现在提醒页）无关：本条是**活动记录的清理能力**，不是提醒触达。

### Version Information

- App 版本：v0.1.7
- 反馈时间：2026-11-05 21:22（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实时活动列表有多条已完成记录，清理时提示「没有可清理的已完成任务」](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261105/20261105_2122_realtime_activity_cleanup.jpg?raw=true)

### 🚀 Background Description
Harden the seven existing E3 task-capability workflows: CHAT-01, CHAT-02, TRAVEL-01, FILE-01, MEMORY-01, TOPIC-01 and STREAM-01. Continue the focused E1 (#626) and E2 (#631) delivery with simple, evidence-based checks that tolerate valid model wording.

### Design Ideas
Bind authenticated cloud answers to actual completed device timelines in isolated test rooms. Check reply visibility and question state, required generated-file navigation and preview content, preference recall across a memory-preserving room change, topic relevance and measured current-reply growth. Record actual question answers instead of assuming a particular first question. Add an English E3 extension guide and retain original device attempts and screenshots.

### Test Design and Test Plan
Test wrong task binding, absent evidence, real room boundaries, sampling plateaus, transient missing UI and question-option selection. Validate workflow definitions and registered versions. Run the current cases on the signed-in emulator and retain every attempt; repeat the same version to assess stability. Submit a dedicated PR targeting main with this issue linked and embedded screenshots.

issue:694.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

DM Home 需要通过统一的会话入口处理文本、附件和原生引用回复，使追问保留原有对话及运行上下文，同时让无关主题进入独立会话通道。

### Design Ideas

- 在 `dm_sessions` 中实现会话邻近路由与核心策略，通过适配器对接引擎、存储、可见性、模型提供方和 WorkSwarm。
- 修复 admission/run permit、事务持久性、终止/取消恢复及运行时 ID 持久化。
- 完善跨重启卸载代次、UNKNOWN 释放排除和有界恢复，保留实际卸载确认与代次检查。
- 处理推断交互 ID 冲突、真实 `ask_user` 提示和原生消息 ID 引用解析。
- 支持容量耗尽时保留草稿、附件和引用，恢复后由用户显式重试；支持会话卸载、归档和携带摘要恢复。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 统一入口正确维持追问上下文并隔离不同主题。
- 容量耗尽不产生多余任务记录，草稿保持完整且不自动发送。
- 卸载、重启、归档及恢复不丢失必要上下文。
- PR 中记录的原生冻结语料最终结果为 36/40（90%），仍存在 2 次错误新建通道和 2 次错误合并；路由延迟尚未达到亚秒目标。
- PR 已提供核心、适配器、服务端和 Node 测试及原生构建、真实运行时 QA 证据；这些为原 PR 报告的结果，冲突修复后的验证另行记录。

实现 PR：#481

详细 QA 与证据见 [PR 描述](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/481)。

issue:698.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

An explicit project directory selected through `room.project` or supplied on a task is stored as `Task.project_path`, but the product Bridge does not forward it when opening the WorkSwarm session. WorkSwarm therefore creates a projectless session, so relative file operations can use its generated task folder instead of the selected project.

User-facing reproduction:

1. Create a local directory containing `notes.txt`.
2. Set a room's `project_path` to that directory using the product engine API (`room.project`), or supply `project_path` with `room.message`.
3. Ask DigitalMate to read `notes.txt` in the current working directory.
4. Inspect the WorkSwarm session metadata: `project_id` is `default` and `project_dir` is empty. The selected directory has not reached the runtime.

The boundary failure is reproducible without a model or any downloads. From an unmodified repository checkout, this standard-library-only check prints the offending call and fails:

```python
import ast
from pathlib import Path

source = Path("harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py")
tree = ast.parse(source.read_text())
calls = [node for node in ast.walk(tree)
         if isinstance(node, ast.Call)
         and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
         and node.func.attr == "open_scoped_session"]
assert calls, "session-opening call not found"
for call in calls:
    print(ast.unparse(call))
    assert any(arg.arg == "project_path" for arg in call.keywords), \
        "Task.project_path is dropped before the runtime session is opened"
```

Observed on main:

```text
backend.open_scoped_session(scope_id)
AssertionError: Task.project_path is dropped before the runtime session is opened
```

A regression test exercising the real Bridge execution/session-selection path also fails before model execution: the session opener receives `{}` instead of `{'project_path': <selected directory>}`. See the visual evidence and the proposed regression test.

Expected: the native WorkSwarm project/session binding should use the selected directory. Continuing the same project should reuse its session; selecting another directory must not silently reuse the old workspace. Requests without an explicit project should keep their current behavior.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product service: Python 3.13.13, tested on macOS arm64 with the service's declared dependencies.
- Native API verification: Linux amd64 Docker, using the repository's v0.1.8 Dockerfile/runtime with the proposed product service source mounted read-only; network disabled and no model calls.
- The direct native API accepts `project.create` followed by `session.create` carrying `project_id` and `project_dir` in `work` mode. Passing only `cwd` does not bind the directory in the product's web channel.
- No HarmonyOS device or model provider is required for the boundary reproduction.

### Additional Information

Related but different: #582 improves directory guidance for projectless tasks; it does not forward a selected product project directory.

Proposed fix: forward the task directory through the Bridge, select/create a native WorkSwarm project, and include the normalized directory in session ownership. Preserve work mode and reject incompatible existing project bindings.

Acceptance:

- [x] An explicit task project reaches native session creation as `project_id` and `project_dir`.
- [x] Same-project reuse and restart recovery preserve the binding.
- [x] Different projects cannot share the same session through continuation.
- [x] Projectless sessions retain their existing behavior.
- [x] Regression tests cover forwarding, isolation, rotation and an interrupted creation response.

Verified against PR #699 at `6833dc93c7aa992b685b5711b4f18bfc69e977a1`. These checks describe the tested PR, not a merged release.

Evidence: the [regression tests](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/6833dc93c7aa992b685b5711b4f18bfc69e977a1/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_workswarm_projects.py) cover all five items: Bridge forwarding plus native project parameters; same-project reuse and restart; continuation into a different directory; unchanged projectless creation; and rotation/lost-response recovery. All 105 WorkSwarm tests and 37 conversation tests passed. The [validation notes](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/6833dc93c7aa992b685b5711b4f18bfc69e977a1/docs/developer_guide/evidence/project-workspace-binding/README.md) also record the successful native Docker API binding/isolation check and its limits. Repository CI is still in progress; live model-driven file editing and device validation are not claimed.

Current PR head: `5753a89b61f47187fe7a0f6c069d7f49acef6cf5` after merging main. Acceptance remains covered; the additional reconnect/runtime-generation regression passed. See PR #699 for post-merge validation and the local runtime prerequisite limitation.

### Version Information

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：手机端回答正文已完整显示，且下方已出现继续追问建议，但输入框右下角仍显示蓝色方块“停止”按钮，没有退出执行状态。

2. 等待回答正文、表格和继续追问建议显示完整。
3. 观察输入框右下角按钮，仍停留在停止图标。

**实际结果**：回答展示完成后，按钮仍表示任务正在执行，用户难以判断本轮是否结束。

**代码分析**：`hasComposerStop()` 读取普通的 inFlight/outgoing 对象及运行时任务对象，缺少对响应式可停止任务列表、发送/回执状态的依赖，ArkUI 在任务结束后可能不重新计算按钮分支。修复让按钮显式依赖页面 @State 状态，保持取消目标仍按本次 submission 绑定。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：点击回答下方的继续追问建议后，建议问题自动填入输入框，输入框上方出现“引用回答”栏。点击该栏右侧“取消”，引用栏消失，但自动填入的追问文字仍留在输入框中。

**复现步骤**：
1. 完成一次问答，等待出现继续追问建议。
2. 点击追问建议，例如“把这篇中秋文章压缩成300字左右的摘要”。
3. 不修改自动填入的文字，点击“引用回答”栏的“取消”。
4. 观察输入框，原追问草稿仍然存在。

**实际结果**：只取消引用，没有撤回此次追问自动填入的草稿，容易误发送已取消的问题。

**预期结果**：
- 未编辑的建议草稿随取消一起清除，输入框恢复空状态，并同步草稿存储，离开再返回不应恢复已取消文字。
- 如果用户已手动改写草稿，取消引用应保留编辑后的文字，避免误删用户内容。
- 普通手动“引用回答”后输入的文字不应因取消引用而被清空；未发送任何任务。

**代码确认**：`chooseSuggestion()` 同时设置 draft 和 replySelection；“取消引用回答”的点击回调仅将 replySelection 设为 undefined，未清理对应自动草稿。问题属于端侧状态管理。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 真机 ICL-AL10；系统具体版本未采集。
- APP v0.1.8（10027）Debug。

### Additional Information

- 与 #719 / PR #720（回答完成后停止按钮不恢复）分开处理。
- 与 PR #717 的 Word 解析、附件缓存功能，以及追问建议语言不一致问题无关。
- 修复范围：仅端侧识别建议自动草稿的来源、取消行为及对应回归测试，云侧不变。

### Version Information

- v0.1.8（10027），调试版。

issue:724.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文注明区别）。
- [x] 已提供群内原始反馈与截图。
- [x] 已按群公告的「现象 / 预期 / 场景」惯例整理（本次为群内对话+截图，非三段式原文）。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：问「附近有啥餐馆」，助手把用户的「当前位置」判定成松江九亭，据此算距离并给出门店清单；用户实际在虹桥，整份结果都建立在错误的位置上，且回答里没有提示这个位置是推测的、也没有确认。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-06 22:18，未央，附截图）：

> 问了下附近有啥餐馆
> 定位都错了哎

同群对话（夏华梁：「你不关注这个位置 是吧😅」；未央：「对的」「我在虹桥哈哈」「这定的哪里😅」）。

同群同学给出的根因判断（姜成林，2026-11-06 23:13）：

> 要定位是要获取用户权限的

截图里助手的原话（把推断位置当成了既定事实）：

> 距离是按你当前位置（松江九亭镇新寅路/小寅社区，上海松江高科技园区一带）算的直线距离；馆子名称、菜系和位置来自 OpenStreetMap 地图标注。地图数据里没有评分，所以"哪家最好吃"我没法用点评分数替你排，以上是就近、可实地去的门店清单。

复现步骤：
1. 在未授权定位的设备上提问「附近有啥餐馆」这类位置依赖问题。
2. 查看回答里的「当前位置」与实际位置是否一致。

实际结果：助手报出一个与用户实际位置不符的地址（松江九亭），并把按该地址算出的距离/门店当作「就近」结果给出，语气是确定的。
预期结果：
- 没有位置上下文或未获定位授权时，不要臆造「你当前位置」；应明确说「我拿不到你的位置」，并给出获取方式（申请定位权限 / 让用户说城市或地标）。
- 若使用 IP 或其他间接来源推断位置，必须标注「这是根据网络推断的大致位置，可能不准，可修改」。
- 位置依赖的结果（距离、就近排序）在位置不确定时不应展示具体距离数字，避免用户误信。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou 手机端
- 版本：报告人未标注；同日晚间另一位同学提交的反馈场景版本为 v0.1.7
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群，2026-11-06 22:18–23:13（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 与 #573（位置依赖查询从不触发定位权限请求、客户端无定位能力、永远回退手动选城市）相关但不同：#573 描述的是「缺能力 → 弹城市选择卡」，#205 描述的是「有权限但 agent 不用」；本条的现场表现是**第三种**——既没有权限、也没有回退询问，而是直接给了一个错误的「当前位置」并据此产出结果。三者可分别修复，本条重点在「位置不确定时必须显式声明，不得当作事实」。
- 回答里还顺带出现了地图数据来源说明（OpenStreetMap），这部分表述是好的；缺的是位置来源的说明。

### Version Information

- App 版本：未标注（同批反馈为 v0.1.7）
- 反馈时间：2026-11-06 22:18（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![「附近餐馆」把当前位置判成松江九亭并据此给出距离](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261106/20261106_2218_wrong_current_location.jpg?raw=true)

### Context

UCD《11月走查-记录.xlsx》“11月走查”工作表第63行，页面为个人中心 → 产物中心；提出人：罗唯。

### Test Environment

- Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 手机端。
- UCD 提供的原始截图未明确标注 APP/系统具体版本，截图时间为09:23。
- 当前 main 代码中同一布局仍存在：个人中心搜索框宽度100%且没有左右内边距，空态文字没有全宽居中。

**问题1**：搜索框左右边缘与底部白色卡片两侧重合，没有留白，显得贴边。

The following PR930 checkpoint preserves its historical source and 10/103 snapshot.

<!-- DM31:FINAL-OBJECTIVES-AND-ACCEPTANCE -->
#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. ### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. Router selects Session and execution path; Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. Both ordinary/simple main modes currently select `agent.work.normal`; do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

issue:884.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已检索相关 issue，未发现报告同类前缀缓存异常的条目。
- [x] 已附复现步骤与所报数据的截图。

### 🐞 问题详细描述

服务端前缀缓存疑似在一个前缀几乎未变化的请求上被完全失效，导致该请求被从头重新计算，而没有复用已缓存的前缀。

**复现步骤**
1. 在对话 `chat-6` 中依次发起请求，直到第 5 次请求（输入 59,019 tokens）。
2. 逐次查看每次请求的缓存统计（见下表）。
3. 将第 5 次与第 4 次对比：第 5 次仅多出 318 个输入 tokens，且与第 4 次相隔 17 秒。

| # | 输入 tokens | 命中缓存 | 未命中 | 单次命中率 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 22,610 | 17,920 | 4,690 | 79.26% |
| 2 | 28,913 | 22,400 | 6,513 | 77.47% |
| 3 | 52,261 | 28,672 | 23,589 | 54.86% |
| 4 | 58,701 | 52,096 | 6,605 | 88.75% |
| 5 | 59,019 | 128 | 58,891 | 0.22% |
| 合计 | 221,504 | 121,216 | 100,288 | 54.72% |

**实际现象。** 第 5 次请求仅报告 128 个缓存命中 tokens：单次命中率 0.22%，未命中 58,891 tokens —— 约占整个会话未命中总量（100,288）的 59%。内部标记显示前缀并未变化（`stable_prefix_changed` 为 false；`system_prompt` 与 `tools` 均未变），但该请求仍被从头计算。这一次调用把 `chat-6` 的整体命中率从约 75%（其余各次）拉低到 54.7%（合计 54.72%）。

**期望行为。** 在前缀几乎未变、距第 4 次请求仅 17 秒的情况下，应当复用已预热的前缀缓存。复用第 4 次约 88% 的命中率，可让 `chat-6` 整体回到约 78–79%，与全局约 80% 的命中率相符，而不是从零重新计算。

### 环境信息详细说明

DigitalMate 移动端 App（v0.1.9）；截图时间为北京时间 2026-11-08 00:55，对话 `chat-6` 共 5 次模型调用。设备型号：huawei nova 16；操作系统：HarmonyOS。

### 补充信息

数据来自所附截图中的缓存/用量统计。说明：
- 第 3 次请求新增约 2.3 万 tokens（消息量从约 12k 增至约 37k）；此处首次未命中属正常冷启动（非异常）。
- 第 5 次与第 3 次请求合计约占 `chat-6` 未命中总量的 82%。
- `chat-6` 仅 5 次调用，单次异常会被整体比例放大；不应仅据此判断为长期低命中率。

建议排查：
- 对比第 4 次与第 5 次请求的前缀差异。
- 检查缓存过期 / 淘汰行为。
- 检查其他对话是否出现相同的整段未命中。

### 版本信息

v0.1.9

### 截图 / 录屏

![chat-6 前缀缓存第 5 次请求仅命中 128 token（单次命中率 0.22%），并含 5 次调用明细](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/9f80a50bc8a7c481717f472ed8b26ebb31157799/.github/issue-assets/884/prefix-cache-128-token.jpg)

## 现象与证据

performance / tooling / P1

issue:900.body:
### Context
对话进行中、助手正在调用工具时的「当前进展」浮层/消息气泡。
路径：对话页 → 发送一条会触发工具调用的消息（本次为「你分析一下现在的session机制是怎样的」）→ 等待回复时弹出的「当前进展」。

### Test Environment
- App：DigitalMate（com.jiuwen.digitalmate）
- 设备：Android 手机（截图状态栏：5G、电量 69%）
- 时间：2026-11-08 11:03（Asia/Shanghai）
- App 版本：0.1.9

### Problem Description & Suggestions
**Observed（现象）**：「当前进展」面板与上方消息气泡都只显示「正在使用工具… · 已用时 33 秒」，不显示正在调用的具体工具名称（如 bash、web_search、read_file 等）。用户只能看到笼统的「正在使用工具…」，无法判断助手此刻具体在做什么。

**Expected（预期）**：「当前进展」中展示当前正在执行的具体工具名称（必要时附一句该工具在做什么），例如「正在使用 bash（执行命令）… · 已用时 33 秒」，让执行过程可观测。

**Suggestion（建议）**：
- 进度文案由「正在使用工具…」改为「正在使用 {工具名}…」，工具名映射为易懂的说法（如 bash→执行命令、web_search→搜索网页）。
- 同一轮调用多个工具时，展示当前工具，并可保留已完成工具列表。
- 与本仓 #896（工具执行缺少超时/进度）方向一致，可一并完善工具级进度展示。

### Screenshots / Recordings
（截图见报告随附：screenshot_20261108_110357_com.jiuwen.digitalmate.jpg）

「当前进展」弹窗原文：
```
当前进展
正在使用工具... · 已用时 33 秒 · 你分析一下现在的session机制是怎样的
```
上方消息气泡原文：
```
Beebou 正在使用工具... · 已用时 ...
```

### Additional Information
- 关联：#896 单条 bash 命令耗时可达 66s 且无超时/进度。
- 归类：过程可观测性——已有进度提示，但缺少「工具粒度」信息。

### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem
In the DigitalMate mobile app's "Live Activity › Recent Topics" list, automatic topic segmentation/clustering is highly inaccurate. Two opposite kinds of errors occur at the same time: unrelated new questions are wrongly merged into the most recent active topic (should-split-but-merged), while questions that clearly belong to the same subject are split into multiple separate topics (should-merge-but-split). As a result the topic list looks randomly grouped.

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-08 21:52 (screenshots at 21:52:23 and 21:52:42)

#### Steps to reproduce
1. In the same DigitalMate conversation, first ask about one topic (e.g. "Can you help me check tomorrow evening's flight back to Hangzhou?"), and get the answer.
2. Then continue in the same conversation with content unrelated to that topic (e.g. "When does Peking University start the semester?" and "Check whether issue #934 triggered the template check and fill in the missing sections").
3. Open "Live Activity › Recent Topics": both of those unrelated entries get wrongly nested under the "flight" topic.
4. Separately ask weather questions in a row, e.g. "How's the weather tomorrow?" and "Today's weather in Shanghai" (two close questions of the same intent).
5. Look at the topic list again: these two same-subject questions are split into two separate topics.

#### Expected result
- A new question with a clearly different intent should be recognized as a new topic and listed independently, not merged into the most recent active topic.
- Questions with the same / close intent (e.g. both about weather) should be grouped into one topic, or at least, at low confidence, suggest a merge instead of each becoming its own topic.
- A topic title should use the most representative user utterance within that topic and reflect its real content, rather than keeping the previous topic's title.

#### Actual result
- Screenshot ① (screenshot_20261108_215223.png, 21:52:23): the topic titled "Can you help me check tomorrow evening's flight back to Hangzhou?" contains, when expanded, two unrelated entries — "When does Peking University start the semester?" (in progress · using tools…) and "Check whether issue #934 triggered the template check and fill in the missing sections" (completed). Both belong to other topics in the current DigitalMate conversation and have nothing to do with the "flight" topic, yet were wrongly merged into it (should-split-but-merged).
- Screenshot ② (screenshot_20261108_215242.png, 21:52:42): in the same list, "How's the weather tomorrow?" and "Today's weather in Shanghai" — clearly the same weather subject — were split into two independent topics; "How's the weather tomorrow?" even showed up on its own as "Searching: Hangzhou tomorrow weather forecast 2026-11-09" (should-merge-but-split).

### Version Information
Reported on the DigitalMate v0.1.9 release (10028).

### Screenshots / Recordings
![Screenshot 21:52:23 – unrelated topics merged into the flight topic](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-933-screenshots/.screenshots/topic-classification/01_topic_merge_215223.png?raw=true)

*screenshot_20261108_215223.png (21:52:23): "When does Peking University start the semester?" and the #934 entry wrongly nested under the flight topic.*

![Screenshot 21:52:42 – same-subject weather questions split into two topics](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-933-screenshots/.screenshots/topic-classification/02_topic_split_215242.png?raw=true)

*screenshot_20261108_215242.png (21:52:42): "How's the weather tomorrow?" and "Today's weather in Shanghai" split into two separate topics.*

![Screenshot 22:00:05 – same over-merge error, another instance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-933-screenshots/.screenshots/topic-classification/03_topic_merge_220005.png?raw=true)

*screenshot_20261108_220005.png (2026-11-08 22:00:05): another instance of the same over-merge bug — "How's the weather in Qingpu, Shanghai next week?" and "Submit issue" (the #935 submission itself) are both wrongly nested under the flight topic "Can you help me check tomorrow evening's flight back to Hangzhou?".*

#### Additional observations / suspicions
1. Two opposite kinds of errors occur simultaneously, which suggests the topic-decision logic itself is unstable — it both merges unrelated short questions into the latest topic and splits same-subject questions apart.
2. Short questions (e.g. "When does Peking University start the semester?") barely overlap with the context keywords, and appear to still be forced into the most recent active topic by reusing the previous topic id, lacking a "clearly different intent → create new" check. (Inference from observed behavior, not a verified implementation detail.)
3. No low-confidence fallback: when the topic cannot be determined, entries are not put into "Uncategorized" or a separate topic, but default into the most recent topic. (Inference.)
4. The topic title appears to be taken from the first/latest activity at creation time and does not update with the topic's content, so the title can mismatch the entries under it. (Inference.)
5. This issue points to the same topic-detection and state-management chain as the "consecutive messages in the same topic blocked by popup" report (see #933) and may be the same root cause.

#### Workaround
No stable client-side workaround; for now ignore the automatic "Recent Topics" grouping and locate specific Q&A via the conversation history directly.

#### Suggested fix direction
- Make new-topic splitting more sensitive: create a new topic when the intent clearly differs from the latest topic, instead of merging.
- Add a confidence threshold: below the threshold, put it into "Uncategorized" or a separate topic, avoiding a default merge into the latest topic.
- Use stronger semantic intent classification and consider the last few turns of context, rather than only keywords / coarse similarity.
- Take the topic title from the most representative user utterance within the topic, and update it as the topic content changes.
- Provide manual merge / split / rename entry points and recycle those corrections as training/evaluation data to improve classification.


Related: #933 (consecutive messages in the same topic blocked by a popup) — likely the same topic-detection chain.

## Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] I understand that a bug report lacking environment information and a minimal reproducible demo may be hard to reproduce and could be closed.

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

In the DigitalMate mobile chat, when an answer renders a Mermaid `sequenceDiagram`, the diagram card shows the chart correctly but keeps a large empty area below the last visible line. The last line is the bottom repeated participant-label row ("请求方 / 云端 / 端侧授权层 / 用户"); below it the card holds a blank band roughly one-plus text-line tall before the next paragraph ("读法三条…"). As a result the card looks like it does not fit its content, and the gap between the diagram and the following text is much larger than normal paragraph spacing.

This is a display-only issue: the diagram content and the surrounding text are correct, only the trailing whitespace / layout is wrong.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open DigitalMate mobile and ask a question whose answer contains a Mermaid `sequenceDiagram` (for example: "把端侧授权层、云端、请求方三方之间的授权与撤销流程画成一张时序图").
2. Wait for the answer to render the sequence-diagram card.
3. Look at the bottom of the diagram card: after the final participant-label row there is a large blank region before the following paragraph.

## Expected result
- The diagram card height should follow the actual rendered SVG content (or the trailing blank be trimmed), so that the following paragraph sits immediately below the chart with normal spacing.

## Actual result
- A large blank area (visually around one-plus line height, clearly larger than normal spacing) remains below the diagram, inside/around the card; the content does not hug the chart bottom.

## Possible cause (inferred, not code-verified)
- The sequence-diagram container likely uses a fixed / minimum height or an oversized bottom padding / margin and does not size to the rendered SVG; alternatively the bottom participant-label row is laid out twice while extra vertical space is still reserved. This is inferred from the rendered screenshot, not confirmed against the front-end code.

## Detailed Environment Information Description
- App: DigitalMate (package `com.jiuwen.digitalmate`), mobile
- Platform: Android phone (mobile client)
- Timezone: Asia/Shanghai
- Observed at: 2026-11-08 22:19:48
- Component: chat answer rendering — Mermaid `sequenceDiagram` card

## Additional Information
- The bug is purely visual and appears whenever a `sequenceDiagram` is rendered in an answer card; the amount of blank space depends on how the diagram is laid out, not on user input.
- Other Mermaid diagrams in the same conversation may share the same card-rendering path; not yet verified.

## Version Information
- App version / build: DigitalMate 0.1.9 (Android mobile client).

## Screenshots / Recordings
![Sequence-diagram card with excessive blank space below the chart (22:19:48)](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-933-screenshots/.screenshots/sequence-diagram-blank/01_blank_221948.jpg?raw=true)

#### 主会话每次更新的必填内容

主会话每次对外进度更新都必须**直接更新正文顶部「总体里程碑与当前预测」**：刷新相关行、下个 milestone 的 ETA/达标判断、整体预测、主要风险、证据依据和时间。**正文为当前计划与状态的唯一总览；不得只更新滚动评论。** 评论用于保留已发生的验收、预测变化、blocker 和范围差异的审计历史，并链接回正文；如已有滚动状态评论，应同步摘要而不另立当前状态权威。一次工具调用不是一次进度更新。每次必须包含：

1. **下一个未完成 milestone、目标时间、预计完成时间和能否达标：ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / MISSED。** 预计时间应给具体日期/时间或有依据的范围；无法估计时标 UNKNOWN，并写清欠缺信息、负责人及取得时间，不能默认为按期。
2. **距下个 milestone 的剩余交付、关键路径、当轮验收增量和证据链接。** 分别报告已合入生产调用、已部署版本、客户端实际验收和按原范围关闭的任务；测试数量和草稿数量不能代替这些结果。
3. **延期风险、负责人、解除时间和应对动作。** 为最主要的 1–3 项写明影响、下一步和备用路径；明确哪些独立工作已转去并行，不能只写“仍在推进”。
4. **两周总目标的当前预测与信心。** 保留 11/22 目标，单独给出真实预计完成日；若偏离，要公开偏离天数和恢复措施，不能静默移动目标或减少原验收范围。
5. **可提前交付项。** 主动检查后续里程碑中已解锁的任务并提前实现、审阅和合入；说明真实的共享 owner/资源串行点，避免把日期窗口变成队列。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

鸿蒙 App 连上云端 WebSocket 之后，只要连接还活着，就会一直挂着，**一段时间没有收到消息也不会主动断开**。

现状（main 上已核对）：
- `DigitalMateSocket` 只有 **75 秒握手超时**，握手成功后定时器会被清掉，之后没有空闲断开。
- `DigitalMateClient` 的默认 **45 秒** 是单次请求超时，不是空闲断连。
- 切到后台时 `setForeground(false)` 只会暂停重连，**不会**主动关掉已打开的 socket。

这会让长连接一直占着，费电费流量，也可能让假活连接一直占着云端会话。

**复现：**
1. 打开 App，连上云端 WebSocket。
2. 不发送新消息，也没有进行中的任务或流式回复。
3. 等待一段时间（空闲时长待定，实现时做成命名常量，默认值待产品拍板）。

**实际结果：** 连接一直保持打开，客户端不会因无消息而主动断开。

**预期结果：** 一段时间没有收到业务下行后，App 主动断开 WebSocket。关闭原因应标明是空闲断开，而不是连接异常；前台不要立刻走 `fail()` → `scheduleRecovery()` 自动重连（否则等于没断）。用户回到会话、回到前台、或准备发下一条消息时再重连。流式回复、pending 请求、进行中的任务不算空闲；协议心跳也不应单独把空闲计时一直续上。

已检索仓库 issue，没有专门跟踪「空闲无下行后主动断开 WS」的条目（[#135](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/135) 是冷启动同时开两条 socket，不是这件事）。本条由原 Feature 表单改写为 Bug。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- App：DigitalMate 鸿蒙客户端
- 代码位置：`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateSocket.ets`、`DigitalMateClient.ets`；横幅文案见 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`
- 对照分支：main
- 关联：长工具调用静默见 [#896](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/896)、[#398](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/398)；若提醒只走这条 WS、没有系统通知，见 [#460](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/460)

### Additional Information

修复落在客户端连接层，不需要新的云端业务 API。空闲时长未指定，确定后补进本 issue。Web 端是否同样做可另开，不阻塞 App。

### Version Information

对照 main 当前客户端连接实现；发布版本未另测。空闲时长待定。

### Screenshots / Recordings

无界面截图：这是连接层缺失行为（连上后无空闲断开），用代码核对说明，不是界面复现图。

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

长任务在等待回复时缺少可读进展。Home 会话展示一个紧凑气泡，从模型显式提供的公开 `progress_text` 中筛选并展示原句，动态三个点表示运行中；过滤空白、少量无信息短句和过短未完成片段，限制逐字符扩展带来的刷新。新合适文案替换旧文案，没有合适内容时保留上一次文案；没有可用公开文案时不凭空生成。

气泡不展开，不读取原始 reasoning 或工具 observation、不增加模型调用；正文开始后若任务仍运行，过程气泡仍可继续更新，结束或待确认时退出。宠物栏保留执行阶段状态，秒级耗时不再显示。历史话题、只读页面及 Agent 详情仍按既有规则排除。

pr:1022.body:
## What

Keep complete JSON object/array replies byte-for-byte intact during web citation presentation. The bridge currently treats URL values as prose citations and silently deletes them when they are absent from its native source registry.

Observed in three search conformance trials: the model retrieved the document through Python/bash and returned the correct answer, source URL and evidence. After an earlier `fetch_webpage` call, the legacy completion cleanup changed every `"source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/..."` value to `"source":""`. Retrieval, answer and evidence checks passed, but all three source checks failed.

The candidate guards the legacy cleanup and opt-in web presentation entry points. It does not infer verified sources from shell text, add source bindings, relax prose citation validation, or change stored benchmark scores. Malformed JSON and prose containing JSON-like fragments still follow existing cleanup.

Related infrastructure: #783 (DM31-M12); this PR does not complete that migration task.

## Routing and scope

- Source: main `77a425ec9e41f114c63574f0d2a8a4bd96549023`; candidate `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd`.
- Supported path: existing `server_engine.server.Bridge._execute_jiuwen`, both legacy and free-search presentation modes.
- Owner: registered `legacy-mobile-gateway` / Mobile Gateway owner (DM31-M01); source/citation migration carry-forward belongs with DM31-M12.
- Writable files: `server_engine/server.py` and the existing `test_web_reply_presentation.py` only. No new module, published interface, Store writer, schema, adapter, or runtime activation.
- Transition: no new adapter to retire. Carry the structured-output regression into the future source/presentation owner at its cutover.

## Before and after

Before: `{"answer":"code","source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/record","evidence":"A fact."}` becomes the same JSON with an empty source.

After: the entire JSON response is preserved. It still has no verified source binding. Ordinary unread prose links continue to be removed.

## Verified

Interpreter: isolated CPython 3.12.15 environment; editable contracts and engine from this exact checkout, bridge dependencies from its pyproject, vendored Mandate wheel, pytest 9.2.0. No production deployment. Offline tests used no credentials; the later live test used the configured model provider through Nullius’s relay without exposing credentials to DigitalMate.

- Red: the six JSON presentation cases fail on unmodified main. Both real Bridge completion regression cases also fail on main (exit 1), including the legacy path that produces the observed empty source.
- Green: focused presentation, unread-citation, source-link and reply-stream tests passed. The expanded nine-file regression selection completed with **204 passed, 8 skipped, 7 failed, 236 subtests passed** (exit 1).
- All seven remaining failures reproduced on unmodified main: one removed search-setting field rejected by configuration, and six SearchSessionTest setup failures from an undefined `ScriptedBackend`. They were not modified or waived.
- Bridge tests use the real execution/completion code and temporary source store. ScriptedBackend supplies controlled tool/model events, and runtime connectivity is stubbed. These are not live model or actual shell retrieval tests.
- Private replay of the three recorded final model answers preserves all three URLs in both presentation modes. The recorded retrieval/answer/evidence checks were already true. This is replay evidence, not a newly scored live run; original results remain unchanged and no run data is included here.
- Architecture manifest check passed (54 owners, no exceptions); Python 3.12 architecture scan found zero findings across 278 files / 32 checked files; all 92 architecture tests passed (exit 0).
- `git diff --check` passed.

Expanded test command (from repo root):

```sh
python -m pytest \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_reply_presentation.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_unread_citations.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_source_links.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_reply_stream.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_search.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_fetch.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_failure_messages.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_policy.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_source_links.py -q
```

The first constrained test attempt could not bind localhost HTTP fixtures; the expanded counts above are from the rerun with those fixture sockets permitted. The first architecture scan used an unsupported Python 3.9 parser; the reported clean scan and tests use Python 3.12.

## Risk / unverified

Complete JSON is treated as data rather than citation markup, analogous to existing protection of code examples. An unverified URL can therefore remain as a JSON value; it must not be interpreted as a verified source. Existing source bookkeeping is unchanged. Maintainer review of this presentation distinction is needed.

This bounded fix does not add provenance tracking for arbitrary Python/bash retrieval and does not fix citation loss in ordinary prose. The live Docker/Muse run and image build below are complete. Phone/HAP tests, full engine suite, deployment, and independent review remain unverified. Keep this draft until the applicable review and runtime gates are satisfied. Revert this commit to restore previous presentation behavior; no data migration is involved.


## Live verification — 2026-11-09

Built the complete upstream Dockerfile at PR head `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd` (APT mirror set to deb.debian.org), then ran Nullius’s unchanged agent.search/v1 kit with `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` through OpenRouter. The existing ACP adapter was retained; the test explicitly selected the candidate image. No catalogue proof or original run result was updated.

- Initial three-check run: **find-source passed**, **disambiguate passed**, **follow-reference ended with HTTP 400: Provider returned error** before producing its final answer. This is a 2/3 initial run, not a clean 3/3 suite.
- Retried only follow-reference once using the standard shard selector, with the same candidate image/model: **passed**.
- All three completed checks passed all four verifier conditions: answer, exact source URL, evidence, and ordered HTTP retrieval. The reference check also retrieved the intermediate page before the final source.
- Therefore every search check has a live passing result with this candidate, with one provider-error retry explicitly retained. The initial run remains failed 2/3; results were not merged or rewritten to hide the interruption.

These are real model calls and real Docker agent/tool/fixture execution, not replay or a scripted backend. This bounded kit result does not establish public-web GAIA performance, phone behavior, or general prose citation provenance.

pr:1025.body:
## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Validation

### Unit tests

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-topics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-delete.test.mjs` on head `487f8fe9` (DevEco bundled Node v24.14.1): 39/39 pass (19 new tests).
- Full Node suite (`tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, `tests/unit/ascf-device/*.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/workflow/workflow.test.mjs`) was run earlier on this branch: 2170 tests, 2117 pass, 45 fail. All 45 are environment-only: missing `typescript`/`playwright`/`ws` (no `node_modules` in either checkout) and a Windows temp-copy `EIO`; the same `Cannot find module 'typescript'` failure reproduces on the untouched primary checkout. Not re-run for the screenshot-only commit `487f8fe9`.

### HarmonyOS emulator verification

Built, installed and exercised the real artifact center on a DevEco emulator; the evidence below comes from the app UI, not from unit tests.

- Source: branch head `487f8fe9` (feature commit `7e46943e`).
- Build: `hvigorw.bat --mode module -p module=entry@default -p product=default -p buildMode=debug assembleHap --no-daemon` with DevEco Studio 26.0's bundled hvigor 6.26.8, `DEVECO_SDK_HOME` = bundled SDK, `JAVA_HOME` = bundled JBR.
- Device: DevEco emulator `Mate 90 Pro`, HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130(SP7DEVC00E130R4P11), API 22. Installed app `com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0 (versionCode 10013, a local build-only bump to allow the install; not part of this PR).
- Signing/login: the HAP was signed with local debug material, whose certificate is not registered with AGC, so Huawei account login fails with 华为账号参数无效. Verification therefore used phone-number login.

Confirmed on device:

1. Entry: BeeBou avatar → AgentDetails → 产物中心 tab, search box `搜索话题或文件名`.
2. Two PPTs generated in one conversation merge into a single topic row showing `2 个产物 · 11/10 15:22`, and the two same-named `微服务架构核心组件.pptx` rows (15:22, 15:19) are both listed — same-name artifacts are not deduped.
3. A different conversation stays a separate group with `1 个产物`.
4. Collapse/expand is per topic: the two-file topic collapses while the other topic keeps its own state; the count and latest time stay on the header.
5. Search by topic-title token shows that topic and all of its files; search by file-name token shows only matching files and keeps the topic heading; no match shows 没有匹配的产物.
6. A collapsed topic is expanded automatically when the search matches inside it.
7. Preview opens, download saves through the system dialog, and the downloaded PPTX renders its two pages — the existing open/download path is unaffected.

Screenshots (also committed under `.github/issue-assets/1048/`):

Topic groups with independent collapse state:

![产物中心：两个话题分组与独立折叠状态](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_artifact-topic-groups.jpg)

Collapsing the two-file topic hides its files and keeps the header count/time:

Search by topic title:

![搜索话题标题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/raw/487f8fe9ba300a169e5cdb3562397cff8cccd5a7/.github/issue-assets/1048/screenshot_20261110_search-topic-title.jpg)

## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

## Summary

Implements the approved scope of `docs/plans/session-artifact-grouping-proposal.md`:

- The server keeps prior artifact receipts for the same task + path, stamps each receipt with its delivery time, and serves a published receipt's immutable snapshot when the deliverable path now points at a later version.
- The DigitalMate client projects a version chain (`artifactVersions`) and a task → conversation owner map (`artifactOwners`), registers history versions in a separate file catalog, and groups the artifact center ("产物中心") by session-affinity conversation. Expanding a topic lists each readable version with a "第 i/n 版" label; preview/open/download/delete are reused.
- Chat cards are unchanged: `artifacts()` still returns only the latest active receipt per task + path. Delete stays local-hide only; no server delete contract was added.

Design and limits: `docs/design/artifact-version-history.md`.

## Server

- `artifact_versions.py`: append-merge receipts, dedupe by receipt id, keep the existing 100-per-task cap.
- `engine_service.py` / `server.py`: use the append merge and add `created_at` from the ledger `applied_at`; wire the snapshot store into the attachments reader.
- `engine_attachments.py`: for a envelope whose path was overwritten, read the receipt's snapshot from `SnapshotStore` after validating receipt, path and SHA-256. Missing or mismatched content fails explicitly with "This version is unavailable"; the current file is never returned as an old version.
- `workswarm_artifacts.py`: byte quota counts retained ids, while the file-count quota stays per path.

## Client

- `cloud-adapter`: `DigitalMateArtifactVersionView` / `DigitalMateArtifactOwner`, `artifactVersions()` and `artifactOwners()` (parent-chain lookup with cycle guard, room-scoped keys, "未归类" fallback).
- `file-service`: optional `versionIndex` / `versionCount` on remote/view/record.
- `entry`: history catalog in `DigitalMateArtifactFiles` (`syncHistory`, `currentHistoryFiles`, `artifactCenterContext`), topic rendering in `DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`, and per-file catalog resolution so chat cards and artifact-center rows each read their own catalog.

python -m py_compile ... (modified server modules)

pr:1039.body: ## Problem Fixes #971. In a later turn or a new conversation, the agent answers "no repository is connected" (or "I can't create issues") even though `gh issue create` already worked in this workspace. The route never became durable: - `MemoryStep` stores only facts quoted from the person's message, so the agent's own sentence ("the sandbox `gh` can create issues here") is never stored. That is deliberate: storing model claims would make a hallucination or a prompt injection durable. - `EditLearner` stores procedural lessons only from user edits, not from successful runs. - Recall is lexical and window-bound, and the GitHub connector inventory has read/comment/prefilled-form operations only, so nothing in the brief said the shell route exists. ## Change Record a route only from a successful tool receipt, and keep it in every brief: - **`server_engine/engine_brief.py`** now holds the capability registry, next to the brief it feeds (so #971 needs no new production module and no ownership-policy change): - `CapabilityRegistry.observe_tool_result` records `github.issue.create` from a successful shell result (`bash`, `Bash`, `shell`, `exec_command`, `commandExecution`, ...). A record needs the create at a command position *and* the issue URL `gh` prints; a grep, echo, comment line or create without a URL is not proof. - A failed receipt marks the record `stale` only when the environment's answer (the receipt's `Command:` echo is stripped) says sign-in or the executable is gone; a repository-scoped denial stales only that repository. A rejected title or body keeps the route. - `brief` renders a short `[capabilities]` section for records that are available and not older than 30 days. A route with no successful receipt is never listed, and background (ambient) tasks get no route to write. - **`server.py`** feeds every `tool_result` frame to the registry, the same frames the activity and breaker paths already read. - **`engine_service.py`** initializes the registry; `assemble_brief` injects the section through the existing `for_agents` gate. - **`ROUTING_NOTE`** tells the model to read `[capabilities]` before declaring an app operation unavailable. Nothing here stores a model-authored claim: only a tool receipt can create a route. ## Tests Run from `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests` with Python 3.13 and `PYTHONUTF8=1`, repo root on `PYTHONPATH`: - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py -q` — **18 passed**: success keeps the route in a later brief; one record per repository; lost sign-in stales and omits it; a rejected create (including a real `Command:/Stdout:/Stderr:/Exit Code:` receipt whose title says "permission denied") keeps the route; a grep/echo/comment mention and a create without an issue URL are not evidence; a multi-line or indented `gh issue create` is recorded; argv-list commands; repository-scoped denial; TTL expiry; ambient tasks; restart. - `pytest test_engine_capabilities.py test_engine_brief.py -q` — **80 passed, 16 subtests passed**. - `test_engine_service.py` / `test_server_scope.py`: 5 failures + 13 errors, identical on the unmodified head of this branch with the same interpreter and `PYTHONPATH` (openjiuwen `AgentSpec` version mismatch), so this change introduces no regression there. - `ruff check` on `engine_brief.py` and the capability tests — clean. (`engine_service.py` has 5 pre-existing F401/F821 findings at the branch head, unrelated to this diff.) - Architecture scan with **both** the base policy (`f02f5d8a`) and this branch's policy — 283 files / 38 checked / **0 findings**; `manifest.py --check` — 56 owners / 0 exceptions. Not run: the complete bridge suite. Its collection needs `pytest-xdist` (not installed here) and `tests/test_model_failure.py` also errors at collection; without `pytest-timeout` the full run hangs, so I stopped it rather than claim a result. ## Limits - Only a route that has already succeeded can be kept. A workspace where `gh` has never run successfully still needs a connector write operation (option B in the issue discussion); this PR does not add one. - Records are workspace-scoped with a 30-day TTL; a lost sign-in or executable marks them stale. ## Verification screenshots DevEco simulator against the isolated deployment (patched runtime on port 20016), same request in both rounds; the keyboard/clipboard area is cropped. The injected `[capabilities]` brief and the `gh: not found` receipt are in the verification comment below. Round 1, no capability record (baseline) — the reply says no GitHub account is connected: Round 2, after a (seeded) capability record — the model attempts `gh issue create` and reports the tool missing: Closes #971

The second Windows device runner (`digitalmate-win-st-03`) shares the `st` label with `digitalmate-win-st-02` but owns a different emulator. The job-level `ST_DEVICE_ID` currently pins both to `127.0.0.1:5555`, so a `st` job scheduled to `-03` also drives the `-02` emulator.

This selects `ST_DEVICE_ID_ST_03` for `digitalmate-win-st-03` at the `Run device ST` step and leaves the repository-wide default for every other device runner. It also documents the new variable.

Validated on the host: `st` job 129683966864 ran on `digitalmate-win-st-03` and reported `ST_DEVICE_ID: 127.0.0.1:5555` before this change; the desired target is `127.0.0.1:10001`.

## Problem and scope

Complete the 2026-11-10 device/cloud calendar design's P2 read-only path: bind an explicit local user grant to the actual admitted task and selected WorkSwarm execution, then allow one private model request to consume the result. Raw tool results and private authority stay outside ordinary conversation state, checkpoints, generic callbacks and frame diagnostics.

This PR remains **Draft** while trusted owner admission, complete isolated server validation, and actual device/provider acceptance remain open. The repaired-source Node, native compilation/Hypium unit and Code Check runs now pass; the standard CI acceptance verdict remains **`local-required`**. P3 date-selection continuation and P4 calendar writes remain outside this change.

Main advanced during publication and included PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation. This update integrates that main, removes the old pre-read/date-parser/text-context helpers, and retains the minimum reader and whole-calendar read permission needed by the P2 tool. Main's location, activity-clock retirement and new trajectory behavior are preserved.

## Changes

- Add private capability/ready/result/cancel messages, canonical scope checks, bounded date windows and UTF-8 payload limits. The device owns intent and consent; explicit refusals and unrelated/third-party requests cannot create grants. Page, account, connection, task and cancellation changes revoke access.
- Connect the actual mobile Bridge, Gateway request, AgentServer, selected InterfaceDeep child, DeepAgent/ReAct tool and final model send. A bounded memory broker permits one read per tool call and one-time consumption of each result, tied to the admitted task, submission, execution epoch and runtime generation. Ordinary tool state retains only an opaque marker.
- Keep private frame bodies out of WebSocket log records before record construction, clear sensitive ingress/error copies, and sanitize provider diagnostic/error extensions. The producer tests drain the real background-memory owner through its public shutdown hook before checking files and provider requests for the canary.
- Require a valid credential-bound provider-policy receipt and a supported HTTPS Chat Completions transport. The receipt is an operator attestation; it does not itself prove a provider's account retention or training settings. Missing, expired, mismatched or unsupported policy keeps calendar access off. Private sends do not retry, redirect or reuse cached raw bodies.
- Preserve current main's retained-context contracts. Calendar capability is supported on the default owned WorkSwarm normal path; hosted/retained, factory and unsupported runtime/provider modes keep it disabled while retaining ordinary chat.
- Declare imported-source changes and first-party additions with strict path/mode/blob checks, preserve original upstream manifests/revisions, and declare the actual broker/caller ownership delta for trusted-policy review. Its formal admission is still blocked, as documented below.

- Fix ArkTS `10605038 / arkts-no-untyped-obj-literals` by explicitly typing the empty capabilities parameters. Extend the actual client/bridge/reader round-trip test to preserve one empty-params request with exactly the existing wire keys. No consent, lifecycle, caching or retry rule changes.
- Add native/device acceptance instructions and a nine-case owner-registration audit; retain original failed results and distinguish every executed participant from pending device/provider evidence.

## Source identity

- Integrated main: `29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28`; actual main merge: `0b1a31bdcf415a9caf6009e1e080a3e8396899e8`.

- Published production fix: `ea7f3ca2d588878dbc2724a11d6494e20ac2dc37`.
- **Tested implementation/test head:** `a0371e039a23f5c737910c7747e9a859423b3f21`; complete tree `95626a2761d0b63889f6e629028438748836070a`.
- **Final documentation head:** `f674f2ca74aa178ed74dbca1cc49a7cf07c3bd2e`; complete tree `eb5e763d1ce5a9c424494802277d93a372668eb0`.
- Both complete remote trees were read back and exactly match the respective frozen local trees, including paths, file modes and blobs. Only six Markdown files changed after the tested implementation head; the passing runs below are explicitly attributed to `a0371e0`, not relabeled as executions on the later documentation head.

## Validation

| Check | Actual source / observed result |
| --- | --- |

| Native compilation and Hypium in CI #1334 | **BUILD SUCCESSFUL; 2,305 tests, 2,305 pass, 0 failure, 0 error, 0 ignore**; job 7 min 30 s. This executes `entry/src/test`, not calendar `ohosTest` or real P2 device scenarios. |

The corresponding local trusted scan reports one AR10 for the new broker, 288 production / 42 enforced modules. |
| Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED preflight | **BLOCKED before suites**, exit 2: inherited host home/credential environment; this environment has no Docker/Podman boundary. The earlier focused server passes do not replace this gate. |

The final gate report records Node and Hypium passes, while ST, architecture-conformance and server-ut-st are skipped in this branch-dispatch profile. ## Problem and change

Refs #1050. After resume, schedule scans repeatedly deserialize all historical tasks/messages for each trigger on the event-loop thread. Reuse the lists for a bounded batch of eight triggers, yield between batches, and invalidate the lists and re-read remaining triggers after every yield/dispatch so intervening task changes or schedule disable/delete are observed. Session maintenance yields between scopes; source checks within one task reuse the same access decision while retaining per-source denial checks.

## Scope and limitations

This is a server-side mitigation, not a full bounded-latency guarantee: a single list load, one large conversation snapshot or a synchronous SQLite call can still block the event loop, and archive transactions are unchanged. The reported SFS/gVisor checkpoint/resume case and first business request require an isolated deployment and have not been verified. Issue remains open until that evidence exists.

A controlled source-extracted cProfile with 591 synthetic tasks and 30 blocked triggers reduced `EngineStore.list` calls from 31 to 5; one run took ~76 ms before and ~13 ms after. Uses in-memory SQLite, minimal Pydantic models and stubbed services; not representative of production timing.

## Verification

- Python 3.12.13, isolated `/tmp/dm1050-venv` editable source, Pydantic 2.14.3. Schedule unit suite: 4 passed. Session-proximity repository suite: 15 passed, including source denial and cooperative scope yield.
- Architecture manifest and policy checks passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Broader pre-final-guard session-proximity discovery: 368 tests, 2 failures and 7 errors in this editable environment, involving installed-owner origin expectations, missing `tests.server` imports and owned-runtime dependency inventory. It is not a passing suite or exact-head CI evidence.
- CCE/gVisor/SFS resume, actual provider/runtime, device, deployment and exact-head CI not run.

## Routing

Base `bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840` (profile baseline c69b766; affected functions unchanged by intervening merges); supported legacy bridge `server_engine`/EngineService path. Schedule/maintenance and source policy stay in their existing owners; EngineStore remains the sole writer, no new persistence or public interface, no migration adapter. Carry behavior forward through DM31-A07/A09 and session-proximity migration; no production cutover is implied.
