## Provenance

Verbatim copy of personal-fork PR [lh913137941/DigitalMate#14](https://github.com/lh913137941/DigitalMate/pull/14), head commit `a6c064c39cf935b36e12b454d93d952d8b097dd5`, pushed unchanged as upstream branch `codex/calendar-p2-lite-20261111` so the device-side slice lives beside its continuation work. The six file blobs are byte-identical to the fork PR head (same commit SHA).

## Known state against current main (read before reviewing)

- The fork base `14249e88a57e7ed57dc4e7c5c9aa518b40676072` is 72 commits behind upstream `main` and predates upstream PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation (`DeviceCalendar.ets` and its permission helpers). This branch therefore **restores the reverted P1 file** and will not merge cleanly into current `main`; resolving that requires a rebase decision, not a mechanical conflict resolution.
- The same author's draft PR #1066 (`codex/calendar-device-bridge`) implements the broader P2 loop on current `main` and **subsumes this slice**. This copy exists as a discrete, reviewable device-side artifact; it is not a competing full implementation.
- Per the fork PR's own scope note: do not use this branch to restore a P1 path that upstream subsequently removed.

## What this slice contains (from the fork PR)

- Shared calendar request/response types, exported through the existing cloud-adapter entry point.
- `DeviceCalendarTool.ets` calls the existing production CalendarKit reader. It validates the task/submission/turn, independently held local grant, expiry, bounded date window and TTL; wire consent alone cannot prompt or query.
- Seven structured response statuses, ISO timestamps, five-field event whitelist, at most 50 sorted/deduplicated events and a bounded UTF-8 response. Unknown date windows never silently become today.
- The shared reader stops subsequent queries after cancellation/revocation. Oversized collection returns `read_failed` instead of claiming an uninspected calendar-order prefix is globally earliest. Exactly 500 collected events still work; the existing stricter aggregate bound is retained.
- Legacy P1 permission-denied guidance remains compatible; the P2 handler maps revocation after I/O began to `cancelled`. Timeout/late-native-result handling is tested.

## Cloud continuation (`e3e6218c`, this push)

The remaining minimal-P2 checklist items, implemented on the copied branch:

- **Page-owned grant issuance/invalidation** — `DigitalMateDeviceCalendarBridge.ets` holds the local grants on the page side; the home composer admits P2 submissions and reads the binding receipt. Revocation and expiry are honored by both sides.
- **Request → task/connection binding** — an admission carrying the top-level `frame.device_calendar` marker mints a transient cloud grant keyed by submission and bound to the admitting socket (`device_calendar.py` `DeviceCalendarChannel`); a successful admission answers with `result.device_calendar = {taskId, submissionId, turn}`. A mismatch closes the grant. The per-channel monotonic `turn` matches #1066.
- **Existing task transport → agent tool consumer** — one engine action `calendar.device_read` served by the same extension registry as the other native tools; exposed to Claude Code/Codex runtimes as `mcp__digitalmate__native_device_calendar` and to the workswarm ReAct runtime as `native_device_calendar` (ToolCard with untrusted-title guidance). No second model transport; no reference-token or one-time-result cache.
- **Duplicate/late response handling** — each device result is consumed exactly once for its live call; expired deadlines, revoked grants and slow consumers release the waiting read with one fixed non-sensitive error (`DeviceCalendarUnavailable`). Device calls ride the admitting socket's own PushOutbox, never broadcast.
- **P2 vs legacy P1 path selection** — a strict P2 consent gate accepts only complete personal-schedule questions; public-event/third-party questions and English negation stay on legacy P1, which keeps recognizing explicit schedule questions when no P2 grant was admitted.
- **Untrusted-title model-result treatment** — the cloud validates the device payload fail-closed (unknown fields, wire caps, ISO windows) and projects only a delimited block with the actual count disclosed; titles are single-line sanitized data, block markers cannot be forged, and denial/failure is never presented as an empty calendar.

### Validation rerun on this push

```sh
python -m unittest harness.tests.test_device_calendar_channel   # 45 tests, OK
node --test tests/unit/device-calendar-bridge.test.mjs tests/unit/device-calendar-intent.test.mjs  # 19 pass, 0 fail
node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs       # 15 pass, 0 fail
```

All touched python modules import cleanly. Native ArkTS build, Hypium UT, real-device ST, full repository CI and cloud/provider E2E **not run** in this session.

## Remaining for the minimal P2 loop

- [x] Device-side handler, shared types and focused production-source tests.
- [x] Actual page-owned grant issuance/expiry and authenticated task/connection binding; duplicate/stale-call rejection.
- [x] Existing task transport -> device handler -> structured response -> actual agent tool consumer.
- [x] Capability negotiation and one explicit old-client fallback; suppress P1 pre-read for admitted P2 submissions; untrusted-title model-result treatment.
- [ ] Native/device tests and complete required CI/architecture gates (merge gate: device ST, then `pr-ready`).
- [ ] Rebase decision on current `main` (P1 revert in scope) and coordination with #1066.

items.author: Evelynn-V
items.body:
## What this fixes

Chinese follow-ups were being split into new conversations:

- #1008: `查询上海天气` → `将以上天气结果显示到一张图片中` → `改为横版 16:9` must stay in one conversation and one artifact.
- #1056: `帮我整理上海有哪些摇滚和金属乐队的现场演出` → `最近乐队演出定的怎么样了？` must continue the shows conversation.

Both are routing defects in `dm_sessions/routing.py`: `_REFERENTIAL` did not cover result references or progress questions, and `_tokens()` kept the whole Chinese run as a single token, so particles and request framing diluted the subject evidence.

## What changed

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py`

- **Continuation intent is modelled separately from topic evidence.** Bounded result references (`以上/上述/刚才` + `结果/天气/清单/图片/表格/…`) and progress wording (`进展/怎么样了/定得怎么样/…`) are evidence, but they never bind a conversation on their own: they still require topic matches, a lexical floor, margin and distinctness. A bare `以上` regex is deliberately avoided — `以上海为例` is not treated as a reference.
- **Chinese tokenization no longer inflates the denominator.** The whole-sentence token is gone; particles (`的了着过吗呢吧…`) and function-word bigrams are skipped; proper-noun characters and internal bigrams are preserved.
- **Output-only refinements follow the server-recorded focus.** `改为横版 16:9` or `把以上结果整理成表格` carries no subject of its own; when the message has no remaining topic word and a focus exists, it continues the focused conversation. With no focus, or with a new subject, it does not.
- **No contract change.** Typed decisions, scope, visibility revision, pending/explicit-reply priority, judge validation (offered candidates only), thresholds and public interfaces are unchanged. English behavior is unchanged (verified: the new token subtraction removes nothing from Latin text).

`tests/session_proximity/test_routing.py` — 18 new tests (`ChineseContinuationTests`) covering: result reference with and without a judge, output-format refinement with/without focus, refinement with a new subject, generic processing without focus, progress question continuing a distinct topic while focus is elsewhere, progress question surviving judge timeout and judge rejection, ambiguous identical topics not guessed, progress topic not binding an unrelated weather conversation, `以上海天气为例`, a new city question, return to a discussion after an intervening topic, result reference with no candidate, and `classify_history`.

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/evals/session_proximity_cases.json` — 3 conversations and 5 holdout cases added (result-to-image, format refinement, shows progress with focus on another topic, processing without focus, false reference example).

## Verification (run locally unless marked NOT_RUN)

Environment: Windows 11, Python 3.11.15, `PYTHONUTF8=1`, `PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src`.

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_eval_corpus tests.session_proximity.test_routing` | **69/69 OK** |
| `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_service` | **10/10 OK** (SessionManager-level, fixture reader) |
| Full `tests/session_proximity` set (9 modules) | **123 tests, 1 error, 1 skip** — error is `test_import_does_not_load_engine_or_backend_sdks`, reproduced identically on a pristine `origin/main` extraction (environment), skip is the Ollama-dependent evaluator runner |
| RED evidence before implementation | 7 of the 18 new tests failed on the unmodified router |
| Deterministic no-judge corpus replay (scratch harness, baseline `origin/main` vs branch) | With the new corpus: baseline **38/47**, branch **41/47**; the three new Chinese positive cases fail on baseline and pass on the branch. The 6 remaining misses are the same pre-existing judge-dependent cases on both sides |

Corpus quality note: an earlier draft of `shanghai_weather_zh` embedded the follow-up text it was meant to detect, which made `existing-weather-result-to-image-zh` pass even on the unfixed router. That leak was removed and the baseline failure above is the proof the case guards the behavior.

## NOT_RUN (and why)

- **Real continuity evaluator run (judge/embeddings)**: no local Ollama at `:11434`; `test_eval_runner` skips. `new-processing-without-focus-zh` and `new-example-phrase-zh` expect NEW/FALLBACK, which is the contract outcome for insufficient evidence, but those expectations are validated only on the deterministic path. Running the evaluator with a live judge is a merge-stage gate; results may need re-calibration.
- **Bridge integration / production admission tests**: the harness runtime dependency `aiosqlite` is not installed on this host; the plan's referenced `test_session_proximity_integration.py` is not present in this checkout. Delegated to CI `server-ut-st`.
- **Device/App reproduction of #1008/#1056**: no coordinated device or cloud environment. Router fixtures are not device evidence.
- **Deployment configuration** (`DIGITALMATE_SPLIT_CONVERSATIONS`, `CONTINUITY_JUDGE_MODEL`, `EMBEDDING_MODEL`, `SESSION_ROUTING_BUDGET_MS`) was not inspected or changed.
- **CI**: not yet run for this branch.

## Out of scope

The entity-recognition/search half of #1056 (`由理生社`, `假假条`) is explicitly separate per the plan; this PR changes nothing there and does not claim it is fixed.

## Risks and limitations

- The cue vocabularies are calibrated on the issue reports and the evaluator's holdout set, not on a labelled production corpus; wording outside these patterns will still fall back to ordinary ranking and the judge.
- The focus-following rule is intentionally narrow (output-processing cue, no remaining topic word, focus present). A subjectless `总结一下` with a focus continues that conversation; without a focus it stays NEW.
- Choosing NEW is not a claim that the user confirmed no relation; ambiguous references still go to the judge when configured.

## Review

An independent whole-branch review (fresh context) found no Critical issues. Its two Important findings were in the eval corpus and are fixed in `ead50ec1`; four Minor findings were deferred and are listed in the PR discussion without code impact.

## Summary

This rebases the device-observed telemetry draft #555 onto current main and corrects timing integrity: a monotonic device clock supplies intervals, empty or whitespace-only frames do not become first text, and v2 reports unobserved stages as null instead of zero. The receiver accepts v1 conservatively and v2 with explicit missing values. It also uses the supported HarmonyOS timezone API.

Related to #972 and #973. This is a candidate successor to #555, not an independent implementation to merge alongside it. It does not establish the terminal-frame or one-way network measurement contract, production readiness, or issue completion. Roll out the v2-capable receiver before the v2 client.

- The test-7 environment and emulator were identified, but no telemetry receiver deployment, device-to-store run, or dashboard publication has been verified.

## Summary

The production dashboard cannot report adapter tool latency because the deployed adapter does not write tool samples. This candidate records opt-in, privacy-bounded tool-call/result durations on the supported WorkSwarm adapter path. It only pairs unique call IDs with explicit matching turn IDs, uses a monotonic clock, records unknown outcomes and coverage counters, and keeps disk I/O off the event loop through a bounded queue. The metrics path is disabled by default.

Related to #974. This does not complete the issue: the downstream dashboard consumer, live deployment, coverage and overhead validation, and independent production-path review remain required.

## Routing and verification

- Owner: existing Harness adapter (`legacy-workswarm`, DM31-A21); supported legacy entry `server_engine.engine_cli serve` and `WorkSwarmAdapter._events`. No new public component boundary or writer for product state.

## Problem and scope

Complete the 2026-11-10 device/cloud calendar design's P2 read-only path: bind an explicit local user grant to the actual admitted task and selected WorkSwarm execution, then allow one private model request to consume the result. Raw tool results and private authority stay outside ordinary conversation state, checkpoints, generic callbacks and frame diagnostics.

This PR remains **Draft** while trusted owner admission, complete isolated server validation, and actual device/provider acceptance remain open. The repaired-source Node, native compilation/Hypium unit and Code Check runs now pass; the standard CI acceptance verdict remains **`local-required`**. P3 date-selection continuation and P4 calendar writes remain outside this change.

Main advanced during publication and included PR #1082, which reverted the older P1 calendar foundation. This update integrates that main, removes the old pre-read/date-parser/text-context helpers, and retains the minimum reader and whole-calendar read permission needed by the P2 tool. Main's location, activity-clock retirement and new trajectory behavior are preserved.

## Changes

- Add private capability/ready/result/cancel messages, canonical scope checks, bounded date windows and UTF-8 payload limits. The device owns intent and consent; explicit refusals and unrelated/third-party requests cannot create grants. Page, account, connection, task and cancellation changes revoke access.
- Connect the actual mobile Bridge, Gateway request, AgentServer, selected InterfaceDeep child, DeepAgent/ReAct tool and final model send. A bounded memory broker permits one read per tool call and one-time consumption of each result, tied to the admitted task, submission, execution epoch and runtime generation. Ordinary tool state retains only an opaque marker.
- Keep private frame bodies out of WebSocket log records before record construction, clear sensitive ingress/error copies, and sanitize provider diagnostic/error extensions. The producer tests drain the real background-memory owner through its public shutdown hook before checking files and provider requests for the canary.
- Require a valid credential-bound provider-policy receipt and a supported HTTPS Chat Completions transport. The receipt is an operator attestation; it does not itself prove a provider's account retention or training settings. Missing, expired, mismatched or unsupported policy keeps calendar access off. Private sends do not retry, redirect or reuse cached raw bodies.
- Preserve current main's retained-context contracts. Calendar capability is supported on the default owned WorkSwarm normal path; hosted/retained, factory and unsupported runtime/provider modes keep it disabled while retaining ordinary chat.
- Declare imported-source changes and first-party additions with strict path/mode/blob checks, preserve original upstream manifests/revisions, and declare the actual broker/caller ownership delta for trusted-policy review. Its formal admission is still blocked, as documented below.

- Fix ArkTS `10605038 / arkts-no-untyped-obj-literals` by explicitly typing the empty capabilities parameters. Extend the actual client/bridge/reader round-trip test to preserve one empty-params request with exactly the existing wire keys. No consent, lifecycle, caching or retry rule changes.
- Add native/device acceptance instructions and a nine-case owner-registration audit; retain original failed results and distinguish every executed participant from pending device/provider evidence.

## Source identity

- Integrated main: `29516ada27d0e9aac208cb0c536f96c9ee42de28`; actual main merge: `0b1a31bdcf415a9caf6009e1e080a3e8396899e8`.
- Initial follow-up head: `e7af3a8c0660ab8f44bb8f2394caab51d4861c7d`; its first native compile failed and is retained in the new record.
- Published production fix: `ea7f3ca2d588878dbc2724a11d6494e20ac2dc37`.
- **Tested implementation/test head:** `a0371e039a23f5c737910c7747e9a859423b3f21`; complete tree `95626a2761d0b63889f6e629028438748836070a`.
- **Final documentation head:** `f674f2ca74aa178ed74dbca1cc49a7cf07c3bd2e`; complete tree `eb5e763d1ce5a9c424494802277d93a372668eb0`.
- Both complete remote trees were read back and exactly match the respective frozen local trees, including paths, file modes and blobs. Only six Markdown files changed after the tested implementation head; the passing runs below are explicitly attributed to `a0371e0`, not relabeled as executions on the later documentation head.

## Validation

| Check | Actual source / observed result |
| --- | --- |
| [Standard CI #1334](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42858633843) | `a0371e0`, normal branch `workflow_dispatch`, all four server inputs empty. **Success**, 10 min 6 s. The successful report's acceptance verdict is **`local-required`**. |
| Node in CI #1334 | **3,442 total: 3,434 pass, 0 fail, 0 cancelled, 8 skip**; job 4 min 43 s. The real pinned-browser runner completed this gate. |
| Native compilation and Hypium in CI #1334 | **BUILD SUCCESSFUL; 2,305 tests, 2,305 pass, 0 failure, 0 error, 0 ignore**; job 7 min 30 s. This executes `entry/src/test`, not calendar `ohosTest` or real P2 device scenarios. |
| [ArkTS Code Check #1819](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42859316858) | `a0371e0`, manual branch run. **PASS**, exit 0, **0 errors / 6,316 warnings / 0 suggestions**, 338 files with findings; 2 min 39 s. Existing rules are unchanged. |
| Affected local regression after the type fix | **196 / 196 pass**, 0 fail/skip/cancel, 4.418 s; overlaps the complete Node run. |
| [Trusted-main architecture CI #1331](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42855656171) | Trusted workflow/main `29516ada`, explicit candidate `e7af3a8`: **FAIL** at `Enforce trusted source policy`. The corresponding local trusted scan reports one AR10 for the new broker, 288 production / 42 enforced modules. |
| Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED preflight | **BLOCKED before suites**, exit 2: inherited host home/credential environment; this environment has no Docker/Podman boundary. The earlier focused server passes do not replace this gate. |
| Final documentation/readback | **PASS**: six reviewed Markdown files, 76 relative links checked, balanced code fences, clean whitespace, exact complete remote tree. |

The final gate report records Node and Hypium passes, while ST, architecture-conformance and server-ut-st are skipped in this branch-dispatch profile. It explicitly requires exact-candidate architecture/server evidence and independent review under #1014. Manual runs do not turn the Draft PR's skipped `pull_request_target` checks into executed checks or grant merge acceptance.

Node reports **76.8% loaded-source line coverage (11,884 / 15,470 lines)** across 56 loaded production ETS files out of 592; 536 files are excluded. This is not whole-application coverage. The local pinned Chromium download remains blocked by an HTTP 200 HTML “Site Unavailable” response instead of a ZIP; the successful remote Node result belongs to its own runner and source.

The [earlier main-integration evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-p2-main29516-2026-11-10.md) retains the original 580 focused client, 68 core/context/observability, 162 bridge/runtime/producer and 28 provenance passes with their exact commands and controlled participants. The client type repair changes no backend/runtime source. Those older results are preserved with their original source and are not claimed as newly rerun suites here. The actual producer's enabled JSONL/rehydrated-SQLite privacy checks and loopback TLS tests remain bounded tests with controlled external phone/provider participants.

The earlier candidate-policy architecture result (288 / 43, zero findings) remains valid only under that explicitly supplied proposed policy. It is **not** a trusted-main policy PASS. The nine registration experiments demonstrate that active policy without source fails, planned registration does not admit production code, and adding the full broker together with policy still fails under the existing trusted baseline.

Detailed current evidence: [native CI follow-up](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-p2-native-ci-2026-11-10.md), [owner-registration prerequisite audit](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/verification/device-calendar-owner-registration-2026-11-10.md), and [native/device validation runbook](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/calendar-device-bridge/docs/developer_guide/device-calendar-native-validation.md).

## Remaining gates

1. **Trusted broker owner admission.** Review the exact 21-added/1-removed-line registry delta and the recorded nine-case matrix. There is no already accepted generic calendar initialization path. A new finite checker-contract producer requires specific maintainer acceptance and independent review under repository change control before implementation. This PR does not weaken the checker, borrow consumed ADR-0017/Root/Hosted authority, or treat candidate policy as trusted. After an accepted producer actually lands, update from real main and revalidate the final candidate.
2. **Complete isolated server LOCAL_REQUIRED evidence.** Obtain the supported isolated runner/image and run the full unmodified enrolled suites, installed-package checks, bounded collector and cleanup receipt. Keep the actual preflight failure visible; focused tests are not a replacement.
3. **Actual product/device acceptance.** Build and record product/test HAPs, install on a specifically allocated device, execute the five registered no-I/O calendar preflights, and perform N01–N09 authorization/read/revocation/TTL/lifecycle scenarios. Native unit success does not establish these results.
4. **Live selected-provider/privacy acceptance.** Verify the actual account/credential policy and supported HTTPS chunked path, then execute and correlate the real phone → broker → owned runtime → provider sequence and durable-output checks. No production activation receipt or provider retention/training evidence is fabricated from fixtures or `store:false`.
5. **Independent final review and applicable final-candidate gates.** Keep this PR open and Draft until the real obligations are satisfied. Passing manual jobs and documentation publication do not authorize merge or deployment.

## Problem and change

Refs #1050. After resume, schedule scans repeatedly deserialize all historical tasks/messages for each trigger on the event-loop thread. Reuse the lists for a bounded batch of eight triggers, yield between batches, and invalidate the lists and re-read remaining triggers after every yield/dispatch so intervening task changes or schedule disable/delete are observed. Session maintenance yields between scopes; source checks within one task reuse the same access decision while retaining per-source denial checks.

## Scope and limitations

This is a server-side mitigation, not a full bounded-latency guarantee: a single list load, one large conversation snapshot or a synchronous SQLite call can still block the event loop, and archive transactions are unchanged. The reported SFS/gVisor checkpoint/resume case and first business request require an isolated deployment and have not been verified. Issue remains open until that evidence exists.

A controlled source-extracted cProfile with 591 synthetic tasks and 30 blocked triggers reduced `EngineStore.list` calls from 31 to 5; one run took ~76 ms before and ~13 ms after. Uses in-memory SQLite, minimal Pydantic models and stubbed services; not representative of production timing.

## Verification

- Python 3.12.13, isolated `/tmp/dm1050-venv` editable source, Pydantic 2.14.3. Schedule unit suite: 4 passed. Session-proximity repository suite: 15 passed, including source denial and cooperative scope yield.
- Architecture manifest and policy checks passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Broader pre-final-guard session-proximity discovery: 368 tests, 2 failures and 7 errors in this editable environment, involving installed-owner origin expectations, missing `tests.server` imports and owned-runtime dependency inventory. It is not a passing suite or exact-head CI evidence.
- CCE/gVisor/SFS resume, actual provider/runtime, device, deployment and exact-head CI not run.

## Routing

Base `bfd3c0fc5625ff5d930a29a838ed210f89933840` (profile baseline c69b766; affected functions unchanged by intervening merges); supported legacy bridge `server_engine`/EngineService path. Schedule/maintenance and source policy stay in their existing owners; EngineStore remains the sole writer, no new persistence or public interface, no migration adapter. Carry behavior forward through DM31-A07/A09 and session-proximity migration; no production cutover is implied.

**What type of PR is this?**
/kind bug

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:
DigitalMate currently exposes both WorkSwarm native web search/read tools and the product search MCP; model turns can mix them, repeat searches and add latency. Register only the product search and page-read tools in the DigitalMate managed runtime, including code mode, even when permission checks are disabled. Keep upstream WorkSwarm behavior unchanged when the product switch is absent. Return the first usable search results without a default merge delay (the configurable `DIGITALMATE_FREE_SEARCH_GRACE` restores a wait). Filter structural navigation, footer, aside and form regions from search page text, while retaining the existing watch extraction behavior and text limits. If search fails, report failure rather than silently inventing results. Native search is no longer a model-visible fallback; product search retains its own parallel-engine and retry behavior.

Routing: product launcher and search MCP own this existing supported WorkSwarm path; narrowly scoped WorkSwarm registration switches retain the upstream default and are recorded in `harness/UPSTREAM.json`. No new state owner or durable schema is introduced.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
No linked issue. Related historical change: #376 introduced product-first search with native fallback.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：
- Source snapshot `587d0d505033cb7900513cec618aef0d45a85404`; branch base `c6b2daeba900aece23f05d33365acacae91978a2`. Compared intervening files: no changes to the tested search/runtime sources; image/build and other changes were not verified.
- Hong Kong Linux Python 3.12, isolated system-site-packages venv; real retained WorkSwarm/agent-core source, locally installed dependencies; mocked external I/O and registration where used. Search policy, MCP, engine, filtering, registration and runtime-policy tests: 89 passed, 1 failed (26 subtests). The failed pre-existing launcher-start test cannot import `jiuwenswarm.runtime.session_unload` in this source-only environment; actual installed-runtime startup was not verified.
- Watch and runtime policy regression excluding that missing-runtime startup test: 31 passed, 1 deselected (13 subtests).
- `python3 -B harness/verify_sources.py` and `python3 -B harness/update_upstream_ids.py --check`: source identity verified / derived IDs current.
- Hong Kong controlled A/B, three Chinese queries x two repetitions, zero search cache, old 1.5 s grace vs new zero grace: all returned 5 results; typical 0.20–0.27 s in both variants, no measured benefit on these samples because the existing full-results fast path already skips the wait. Partial-result/cancellation behavior is covered by unit test; no end-to-end speedup claim.
- CI, real deployed managed runtime and device validation not yet run. Search-result relevance and webpage extraction quality need evaluation on a representative corpus.

**Self-checklist**:
+ - [ ] **Design**: Maintainer review completed and comments resolved.
+ - [ ] **Test**: Full UT/ST coverage completed.
+ - [x] **Verification**: Scenarios, results and limitations are described above.
+ - [ ] **Interface**: External interface changes reviewed and annotations refreshed if applicable.
+ - [ ] **Document**: Official website documentation handled if applicable.


**Additional search-only paired benchmark (Hong Kong)**: 8 Chinese queries x 2 repetitions per variant, alternating order, cold search cache and reset cooldown, limit 5. Old grace 1.5 s: median 0.236 s (16/16 calls, 80 results); new grace 0: median 0.260 s (16/16, 79 results); median paired old-minus-new -0.002 s. This does not establish a real-network speedup; most first responses already filled the limit and skipped old grace. Controlled substitute: first engine returns one usable result after 0.05 s, second waits 3 s: old 1.552–1.553 s vs new 0.051 s; 1 result each. Search-only, not model/tool discovery/page-read/end-to-end; no relevance or deployment parity claim.

items.body:
## Summary

Refs #464 and #1010. The two reported forms have regression coverage; end-to-end device and live-model acceptance remains outstanding.

After a conversation is summarized, routing snapshots carry only the topic card and summary (`retrieval=True`), so the previous assistant bubble is not part of the routing document. When that reply proposed a concrete action but the summary does not repeat its wording, a short confirmation such as `加上` / `加吧` / `发吧` has no lexical or semantic evidence to continue the discussion. The router then returned NEW, the turn ran without plan history, and the assistant re-asked which domain and which PR to act on.

This change binds a message that only confirms or continues the previous turn and names no subject of its own to the recent focused conversation. Because the selected conversation is admitted with its full exchanges, the turn again sees the previous proposal (the named PR and label) instead of losing it.

The rule deliberately stays narrow:

- requires an existing focus (`focused_conversation_id`),
- requires the focus to be inside the existing recency window,
- ignores messages with attachments,
- ignores the focused snapshot when it is `control_only`,
- also recognizes a bounded label instruction with a recent, uniquely identified PR in the visible original exchanges; ambiguous or ineligible cases use ordinary routing.

`Basis.FALLBACK` is used for the EXISTING decision to keep the public `Basis` contract unchanged.

## Review follow-up

- **F1 (compound confirmations) — fixed.** `_is_continuation_only` accepts a message whose clauses, split on punctuation/whitespace, all match the continuation vocabulary; a trailing courtesy word (`谢谢` / `多谢` / `please` / `pls`) is stripped first. A clause with its own subject (`好的，帮我订机票`) still keeps the whole message on ordinary routing.
- **F2 (Chinese negatives) — fixed.** `取消` / `不用` / `不了` / `不行` / `否` now bind like their English counterparts (`cancel` / `no`).
- **F3 (subject-bearing label follow-up) — implemented with bounded evidence.** Recent visible original exchanges supply a unique PR for the reported `Markt the ready label` case, including when the continuity judge is unavailable. This selects a conversation, not an action authorization. Multiple PRs and missing, stale, archived, control-only or attached context do not use this fallback. Live product acceptance is still required.
- **F4 (polite confirmations and `开始`) — fixed.** `_COURTESY_SUFFIX` now strips `please` / `pls` and re-normalizes the clause so the separating whitespace does not survive, and `开始` joins the subject-free continuation verbs. Covered by `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`; `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` still route NEW.

## Tests

Added to `tests/session_proximity/test_routing.py`:

- `test_bare_continuation_binds_the_focused_discussion_after_its_reply_is_summarized` (covers `加上`, `加吧`, `发吧`, `好的`, `继续`, `收到`, `sounds good`, `go ahead`, `取消`, `不用`, `开始`, `开始吧`, `yes please`, `sure, please`, `ok please`)
- `test_compound_confirmation_clauses_bind_the_focused_discussion` (covers `好的，加上吧`, `好，加上`, `加上吧谢谢`, `好的、加上`, `加上,发吧`, `好的！加上吧`, `好的，开始吧`, `开始吧谢谢`, `好，开始 please`, plus the `好的，帮我订机票`, `please add the label` and `开始处理购物清单` counterexamples)
- `test_bare_continuation_does_not_follow_a_stale_focus`
- `test_bare_continuation_still_needs_a_focus`
- `test_short_instruction_with_its_own_subject_does_not_bind_focus`

Commands run (`PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src`, `PYTHONUTF8=1`):

- `python -m unittest tests.session_proximity.test_routing` — 36 tests, OK
- all `tests/session_proximity/test_*.py` modules — 96 tests, OK (1 benchmark test skipped: local Ollama not reachable)
- `tests.session_proximity.test_contracts.ImportIsolationTests` — OK (the suite's `path.read_text()` needs `PYTHONUTF8=1` on this Windows host; without it the pre-existing locale decode issue appears)

Not executed: `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_session_proximity*.py` integration tests, because this environment lacks the harness runtime dependencies (`aiosqlite` first). No build or runtime verification of the HarmonyOS client was performed.


## Follow-up verification at 7834bbb7

- python -m unittest discover -s tests/session_proximity -p 'test_*.py': 99 tests passed, one local Ollama benchmark skipped (before the final additional negative case); targeted routing: 40 passed.
- Repository integration: 15 passed, including real SQLite retrieval, no-judge routing and rebuilding the selected conversation history. Model provider serialization: 7 passed using a controlled provider.
- Architecture manifest and static gate: passed, zero findings.
- Interpreter: E:/miniforge3/python.exe; mandate loaded from the repository vendor wheel. The broader source-discovery run did not pass: three imports required missing telethon and three installed-package/provenance checks failed under this source environment.
- Not yet verified: live model, deployed server, HarmonyOS emulator and the actual GitHub label operation. No screenshot or end-to-end acceptance is claimed.

## Summary

Group the DigitalMate product-center artifacts by the authoritative session-affinity topic instead of showing one flat list. The artifact center is a read-only projection: `DigitalMateConversation.artifactTopicAssignments()` maps `taskId -> conversationId -> conversation title` from the existing `session_proximity` snapshot, walks `parent_task_id` for child artifacts, and degrades missing or cyclic parents to 未归类. Display identity is always the ID-based key, so retitling a conversation changes only the label.

`ArtifactPresentation.artifactTopicGroups()` is a pure, unit-tested function: same-topic tasks merge, same-title conversations stay separate, same-name files are not deduped, files sort by generation time with a stable fallback, and search matches the topic title (all files) or individual file names (only matches). The page renders expandable topic rows with count and latest time, preserves loading/retry/empty/no-result states, and reuses the existing preview/open/download/delete actions. No second artifact write path, no new download, and no change to session-affinity classification or routing.

Closes #1048

## Validation

### Unit tests

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-topics.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-versions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-artifact-center-delete.test.mjs` on head `487f8fe9` (DevEco bundled Node v24.14.1): 39/39 pass (19 new tests).

All 45 are environment-only: missing `typescript`/`playwright`/`ws` (no `node_modules` in either checkout) and a Windows temp-copy `EIO`; the same `Cannot find module 'typescript'` failure reproduces on the untouched primary checkout. Not re-run for the screenshot-only commit `487f8fe9`.

### HarmonyOS emulator verification

Built, installed and exercised the real artifact center on a DevEco emulator; the evidence below comes from the app UI, not from unit tests.

- Source: branch head `487f8fe9` (feature commit `7e46943e`).

- Device: DevEco emulator `Mate 90 Pro`, HarmonyOS 6.0.0.130(SP7DEVC00E130R4P11), API 22. Installed app `com.jiuwen.digitalmate` 0.1.0 (versionCode 10013, a local build-only bump to allow the install; not part of this PR).
- Signing/login: the HAP was signed with local debug material, whose certificate is not registered with AGC, so Huawei account login fails with 华为账号参数无效. Verification therefore used phone-number login.

Confirmed on device:

1. Entry: BeeBou avatar → AgentDetails → 产物中心 tab, search box `搜索话题或文件名`.
2. Two PPTs generated in one conversation merge into a single topic row showing `2 个产物 · 11/10 15:22`, and the two same-named `微服务架构核心组件.pptx` rows (15:22, 15:19) are both listed — same-name artifacts are not deduped.

4. Collapse/expand is per topic: the two-file topic collapses while the other topic keeps its own state; the count and latest time stay on the header.
5. Search by topic-title token shows that topic and all of its files; search by file-name token shows only matching files and keeps the topic heading; no match shows 没有匹配的产物.
6. A collapsed topic is expanded automatically when the search matches inside it.
7. Preview opens, download saves through the system dialog, and the downloaded PPTX renders its two pages — the existing open/download path is unaffected.

## Version history (blocked server dependency)

- Client keeps only the last receipt per `(taskId, path)` (`DigitalMateConversation.ets:1100-1106`).

- Baseline: `origin/main` `c6845d4b` after rebasing the branch (earlier base `4ed211e0`).
- Authoritative writer: session proximity remains the sole owner of conversation identity and titles; this PR adds only a read-only projection. Legacy `topic_id`/`thread_id` data keeps a stable fallback key. No server or persistence changes.

## What & why

Issue #353 asks for a WeChat-style "新消息" experience. The bot review on the
issue correctly found that the floating "↓" button already exists
(`showJumpToLatest` / `jumpToLatest`), so this PR implements only the part that
was actually missing:

- **Unread boundary.** When the reader leaves the bottom of the list, the last
  settled row is recorded. A live stream row is skipped on purpose: when it
  commits it becomes a different row id, and the finished reply must still
  count as new.
- **"新消息" divider.** The first assistant reply after that boundary carries a
  blue "新消息" divider (rendered inside its `ListItem`, so list indices used by
  `scrollToIndex` stay stable).
- **"↓ 新消息" button.** The existing floating button now shows the unread label
  and count (capped at `99+`), plus an accessibility label. With no unread
  replies it stays the plain "↓" as before.
- **Clearing.** Reaching the first unseen reply advances the boundary (the
  divider moves to the next unseen one); jumping to the latest or reaching the
  bottom clears the state. Switching room/topic or changing account resets it.

Nothing changes when the user is at the bottom: the list keeps auto-following
and no hint appears.

## Tests

New `tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs` covers the three states
from the issue (at bottom / reading history / returning to the page), the
stream-row edge case, divider advancement and jump clearing.

`gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs` loads the new helpers because it exercises
`setFollowLatest`/`render` in isolation.

```
node --test tests/unit/gateway-cloud-ui.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-pending-card-in-stream.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-topic-async.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-notifications.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-stream-presentation.test.mjs \
  tests/unit/digitalmate-unread-indicator.test.mjs
# 184 tests, 184 pass
```

The full `tests/unit/*.test.mjs` run has 5 failures that are environmental on
this machine (missing Playwright browser binaries; `EPERM: fsync` in the
worktree for the AGC SMS tests) and unrelated to this change.

**Not verified on a HarmonyOS device** (no build/device available here), so no
screenshot/recording is attached. Please run the ArkTS check and a device smoke
test before merge.

Fixes #353

## What this fixes

Issue #381: a task failure surfaced the internal component name **Orbit** and told the user to “让 Orbit 修正请求”, which no user can act on. The string originates in the cloud pipeline, but the client had no last line of defence and rendered it verbatim in the bubble.

This is a client-side filter at the existing display boundary, not a server change:

- New `digitalmateInternalComponentDiagnostic(text)` detects the narrow pattern “Orbit + 让Orbit修正/重试/修正请求” (not every mention of the word).
- New `digitalmateInternalFailureText()` returns actionable copy: “这一步没有成功，请稍后重试或换个问法；如果仍然失败，可以联系服务管理员。”
- `digitalmateUserVisibleText()` now applies it after the existing environment-diagnostic filter.

**Reachable call path:** `digitalmateUserVisibleText()` is called when projecting stored messages (`DigitalMateConversation` line 483), when projecting streamed text (line 894), and through `visibleTaskText` for task summaries; notifications use `digitalmateTaskFailureText` for failed tasks. No new module and no unreferenced code: the function was already on every user-visible text path.

Fixes #381

## Red-first, as real commits

- `dd407ed` — **test only**: 3 tests added to `tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs`.
  `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs` → **11 pass / 2 fail**, exit 1. Both failures are real assertions on existing code, not ENOENT:
  `AssertionError: The input was expected to not match the regular expression /Orbit|修正请求/. Input: '这次请求尚未完成。…Orbit 向应用发送的请求不符合要求。请让 Orbit 修正请求后再试。'`
- `b76b57e` — implementation only. Same command → **13/13 pass**, exit 0.

## Tests run

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-user-text.test.mjs` (red) | 11 pass / 2 fail, exit 1 |
| same (green) | 13 pass / 13, exit 0 |
| `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs` | 1013 tests, 1010 pass, 3 known env failures (`typescript` ×2, `playwright` ×1) |
| `node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs` | 1637 tests, 1598 pass, 32 fail, 7 skipped |
| baseline `04621bb` | 1634 / 1595 / 32 / 7 |

Delta is exactly the 3 new tests; the 32 failures are the known environment gaps.

**Not run locally:** `hvigorw`/ArkTS build (no HarmonyOS toolchain here). CI `ArkTS Code Check` and `node-ut` run on this head.

## CI

- `node-ut`: **success**
- `ArkTS Code Check`: **success**
- `hypium-ut`, `auto-review`, `claude-mention`: skipped by repo defaults

## Review

No independent review is possible: the DigitalMate Reviewer bot has no GitHub identity/token in this environment, so it cannot post. **No review was posted, no self-review was dressed as independent, and no review id is invented.** Review is reported as `not run`.

## Privacy / security / rollback

- No secrets, no prompt/response bodies, no new imports, no permission widening.
- The filter only replaces a narrow internal-failure sentence; a genuine user question such as “Orbit 是什么？” is preserved (covered by a test).
- Rollback: `git revert dd407ed..b76b57e`.

items.body:
## 决定：URL 边界与 #408 同构（方案 a），另补回基线本来就排除的 `]` 和 `}`

执行过程提取来源链接时，采用 #408 在 `CloudMessage.ets:143` 定下的那条边界——`https?:\/\/` 后不允许空白、引号、尖括号、`(`/`)` 以及 CJK/全角标点区段（`\u2000-\u206f`、`\u3000-\u303f`、`\u3400-\u4dbf`、`\u4e00-\u9fff`、`\uff00-\uffef`）。理由：`brief()` 遮的是同一类工具文本，本函数从同一份 `step.text` 里取链接，两处边界一旦分叉，同一句中文里的同一个 URL 会在遮罩面和点击面得到两个不同结果。

在这条边界上只有三处**为「可点击」服务**的差异，都写进了代码注释：

1. **补回 `]` `}`**：基线原类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` 本来就排除这两个字符，而 `#408` 的遮蔽类省掉了它们。遮蔽时多带一个字符无害；这里要把 URL 交给 `openLink`，`见 [https://example.com/a] 结束` 就会点开 `https://example.com/a]`（404）。所以边界用「#408 的类 + `\]` `\}`」。
1b. **CJK 汉字留在地址里**（评审 High，已在 `376d004` 修）：#408 的类停在中日韩汉字上，那对**遮蔽**是对的（它替换字节），但对**要打开的链接**会把 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中文` 砍成站点根 `https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/`（实测），这比「吞一句正文」更糟。所以地址里允许 CJK 汉字、只以 CJK/全角**标点**收尾——这正是气泡自动链接 `CloudMarkdown.ets:75` 已经在用的同一套切法。标注一句残余：`https://example.com/a其中3条`（汉字紧贴 ASCII 且无标点）仍会被吞进地址，与气泡行为一致，属已知取舍。
2. **成对括号回接**：边界把 `(` 整组切掉，而维基式地址 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Function_(mathematics)` 的括号属于地址。这里在边界之后仅回接**配平**的括号组（含嵌套）；不配平的 `(`/`)` 仍留在地址外。
3. **ASCII 句末标点**：`.,;:!?*` 不属于地址（`。`、`，` 已由区段排除）。尾部连续剥掉；路径里的 `/`、`%`、`=`、`&`、`#`、`?` 不动（有测试钉住）。`https://x.com/a?` 这类空查询会被剥成 `https://x.com/a`，打开的是同一页面，判断为可接受。

没有把 `CloudMessage.ets` 里的字符类抽成共享常量：该文件正被 #408 占用，本轮不碰（这是本轮唯一的重复，注释里写明指向 `CloudMessage.ets:143`）。

## 改了什么

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/CloudExecutionViewModel.ets`：`executionResources()` 的链接提取改用上述边界，并在入结果集合前做配平括号回接与句末标点裁剪；`seen` 去重、`titles` 映射（查不到时回退到未修剪的原始匹配）、文件路径提取、其他规则都不变。
- `tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`：新增 6 个测试（边界、括号、合法 URL 语法、去重计数、文本紧邻中文、`]`/`}` 包裹），**没有改动任何既有断言**（diff 里 `^-[^-]` = 0）。

修好后：来源行展示与点击打开的 URL 一致；同一 URL 带不同尾部标点只算一个来源。

## 可达链与单一数据通路（release 路径）

- 渲染：`CloudMessageCard.ets:392-405` → `onOpenProcessLink(link.url)`；详情面板 `Index.ets:1996-2001` → `openProcessLink(item.url)`
- 打开：`Index.ets:1927-1938`，只校验 `/^https?:\/\//` 就 `host.openLink(url)`
- 计数：`CloudExecutionViewModel.ets:237`（`executionWebSourceCount` 内部 `flatMap(step => executionResources(...))`）、`:254-256`（`executionDetailLabel` 同样 `flatMap(executionResources(...))` + `new Set(...)`）——**没有第二条正则**，计数跟着同一个函数走

## 证据（`main@7fbaa28`，node v24.22.2）

命令：`node --test tests/unit/cloud-execution-view.test.mjs`

| 状态 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 未修（仅加断言） | `32 tests / 26 pass / 6 fail` |
| 修复后 | `32 tests / 32 pass / 0 fail` |
| M1 边界换回旧字符类 `[^\s"'<>\]\}]+` | 6 红（边界、括号、计数、中文路径/正文、括号注释、标题） |
| M2 `balancedParenTail()` 直接 `return end;` | 1 红（只有括号那条） |
| M3 去掉 `trimSourceUrl` 尾部剥离 | 1 红（只有边界那条） |
| M4 从边界里删掉 `\]` | 1 红（只有 `]`/`}` 包裹那条） |
| M5 从边界里删掉 `\u3000-\u303f`（中文标点区段） | 4 红（边界、计数、中文路径/正文、标题） |
| M6 去掉括号组里的 `#` 守卫 | 1 红（只有「括号注释不回接」那条） |
| 还原 | 30/30 绿 |

每次变异后都回读了被改行（例：M4 回读 `219: const SOURCE_URL: RegExp = /https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>()\}\u2000-…]+/g;`，M5 回读同位置只剩 `\u3400-\u4dbf`），确认改动真的落盘再跑测试。

既有 importers 回归：`cloud-chat.test.mjs` 157/157、`cloud-page-state.test.mjs` 22/22、`execution-status-header.test.mjs` 2/2。

未运行：`hvigorw` 构建、真机 Hypium、全量 `tests/unit`（只跑与本文件相关且会 import 它的用例）。

## 提交

- `a27aa09e545488bcca1ba8642449b7ef6f6679d2`：边界 + 括号 + 尾部标点 + 4 条测试
- `0766d416949d02bad9c8bdef6ed37be5ba28e017`：补回 `]`/`}` + 2 条测试（M4 的落点）
- `376d004493d853a5c3b95043ed660d04b0cca4b7`：CJK 汉字留在地址里（评审 High）+ 括号注释守卫 + 2 条测试（M5/M6 的落点）

## 冲突面

42 个 open PR 里没有任何一个改动这两个文件（#408 占 `CloudMessage.ets`、#472 占 `A2uiHome/Index.ets`，都不重叠）。

Fixes #498

**What type of PR is this?**

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Nightly Simulator E2E 目前只把 `DM-WF-CHAT-01` 的**执行状态**当门禁，AI 评分是 informational（`REQUIRE_AI_SCORE=false`）。因此像下面这些已经修过、但只在截图/`ui/*.json` 里才能看出来的 DigitalMate 对话缺陷，回归时不会被任何确定性门禁拦住。

| 规则 | 级别 | 来源 issue | 检查内容 | 证据面 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `internal-payload` | 阻塞 | #306 #256 | 正文不得出现 `Next:`/`Reminder:` JSON、`orbit_*`/`mcp_*` 工具名、`agent_id` 等协议字段 | UI 文本 |

| `stale-no-reply-hint` | 阻塞 | #218 | `COMPLETED` 用例不得残留「没有得到可用回复」气泡 | UI 文本 |

| `bare-source-domain` | 提示 | #305 #326 | 来源不得是整段不可点击的裸域名；`--strict` 时升级为阻塞 | UI 节点 `text` + `clickable` |

接入方式：

  `node tests/e2e/workflow/conversation-gate.mjs --run-dir artifacts/e2e-workflow/<runId>`。
- 某条用例如果本来就要渲染内部错误，在脚本顶部 `EXEMPT` 里按用例 id 显式列出规则，不放宽全局规则。

## 背景

bot（`agent-CI-Infra-bot`）的检视打标原先是通用规则：按 `type/*`、`priority/*`、`area/*` 这类斜杠轴选标签，并把 `priority/medium` 当默认。这与本仓库实际标签体系不匹配——这里是 `priority:P0/P1/P2`、`client`/`backend`/`hybrid`、`source:*`、`channel:*`。结果是模型选出的名字大多落在 `repository_labels` 之外，被控制面静默丢弃，等于不分类。

## 本 PR 做了什么

- 新增 `.bot/rules/labels.md`。这是 bot 文档规定的仓库级规则路径（`docs/rules.md`），整份覆盖内置 `labels.md`，每次检视都会注入。
- 规则内容对齐 #996 的 `.agents/skills/digitalmate-issue-triage`：只处理未指派且类型为 bug / UX / Experience feedback 的 Issue；四个维度（技术范围、优先级、source、channel）各最多一个值；优先级必须恰好一个 P0/P1/P2；只用现有标签，不新建、不改名；不覆盖人工已给的维度。
- 保留首行 `review_label: bot-reviewed`，检视标签行为不变。
- 全部标签名已对照仓库线上 43 个标签校验，无自造名称。

## 与 #996 的关系

#996 的 skill 已经在 main 上，bot 会把 `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 作为按需 skill 索引（`docs/rules.md`）。但 skill 是按需读的，而 `labels.md` 是每个任务都注入的规则层。两份配合：本文件负责“每次检视必须怎么选标签”，skill 负责“分诊细节和责任田”。

## 生效方式

规则只从默认分支读（PR 内的改动不影响当次任务）。合入 `main` 后，下一次 Issue 检视即按新规则打标。注意：本 PR 改了 `.bot/`，bot 检视这个 PR 时会在总结里提示“改变了 bot 行为，需要人决定”，这是预期行为。

## 范围影响

feature / documentation / RFC / Competition feedback 等类型不再添加分类标签，只保留 `bot-reviewed`；这与 #996 skill 的 issueScope 一致。如果希望 feature 也自动分类，需要在后续 PR 里放宽本文件的处理范围。

items.author: aitianshi
items.body:
## What

Keep complete JSON object/array replies byte-for-byte intact during web citation presentation. The bridge currently treats URL values as prose citations and silently deletes them when they are absent from its native source registry.

Observed in three search conformance trials: the model retrieved the document through Python/bash and returned the correct answer, source URL and evidence. After an earlier `fetch_webpage` call, the legacy completion cleanup changed every `"source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/..."` value to `"source":""`. Retrieval, answer and evidence checks passed, but all three source checks failed.

The candidate guards the legacy cleanup and opt-in web presentation entry points. It does not infer verified sources from shell text, add source bindings, relax prose citation validation, or change stored benchmark scores. Malformed JSON and prose containing JSON-like fragments still follow existing cleanup.

Related infrastructure: #783 (DM31-M12); this PR does not complete that migration task.

## Routing and scope

- Source: main `77a425ec9e41f114c63574f0d2a8a4bd96549023`; candidate `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd`.
- Supported path: existing `server_engine.server.Bridge._execute_jiuwen`, both legacy and free-search presentation modes.
- Owner: registered `legacy-mobile-gateway` / Mobile Gateway owner (DM31-M01); source/citation migration carry-forward belongs with DM31-M12.
- Writable files: `server_engine/server.py` and the existing `test_web_reply_presentation.py` only. No new module, published interface, Store writer, schema, adapter, or runtime activation.
- Transition: no new adapter to retire. Carry the structured-output regression into the future source/presentation owner at its cutover.

## Before and after

Before: `{"answer":"code","source":"http://web-search:9001/documents/record","evidence":"A fact."}` becomes the same JSON with an empty source.

After: the entire JSON response is preserved. It still has no verified source binding. Ordinary unread prose links continue to be removed.

## Verified

Interpreter: isolated CPython 3.12.15 environment; editable contracts and engine from this exact checkout, bridge dependencies from its pyproject, vendored Mandate wheel, pytest 9.2.0. No production deployment. Offline tests used no credentials; the later live test used the configured model provider through Nullius’s relay without exposing credentials to DigitalMate.

- Red: the six JSON presentation cases fail on unmodified main. Both real Bridge completion regression cases also fail on main (exit 1), including the legacy path that produces the observed empty source.
- Green: focused presentation, unread-citation, source-link and reply-stream tests passed. The expanded nine-file regression selection completed with **204 passed, 8 skipped, 7 failed, 236 subtests passed** (exit 1).
- All seven remaining failures reproduced on unmodified main: one removed search-setting field rejected by configuration, and six SearchSessionTest setup failures from an undefined `ScriptedBackend`. They were not modified or waived.
- Bridge tests use the real execution/completion code and temporary source store. ScriptedBackend supplies controlled tool/model events, and runtime connectivity is stubbed. These are not live model or actual shell retrieval tests.
- Private replay of the three recorded final model answers preserves all three URLs in both presentation modes. The recorded retrieval/answer/evidence checks were already true. This is replay evidence, not a newly scored live run; original results remain unchanged and no run data is included here.
- Architecture manifest check passed (54 owners, no exceptions); Python 3.12 architecture scan found zero findings across 278 files / 32 checked files; all 92 architecture tests passed (exit 0).
- `git diff --check` passed.

Expanded test command (from repo root):

```sh
python -m pytest \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_reply_presentation.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_unread_citations.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_source_links.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_reply_stream.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_search.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_web_fetch.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_web_failure_messages.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_search_policy.py \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_source_links.py -q
```

The first constrained test attempt could not bind localhost HTTP fixtures; the expanded counts above are from the rerun with those fixture sockets permitted. The first architecture scan used an unsupported Python 3.9 parser; the reported clean scan and tests use Python 3.12.

## Risk / unverified

Complete JSON is treated as data rather than citation markup, analogous to existing protection of code examples. An unverified URL can therefore remain as a JSON value; it must not be interpreted as a verified source. Existing source bookkeeping is unchanged. Maintainer review of this presentation distinction is needed.

This bounded fix does not add provenance tracking for arbitrary Python/bash retrieval and does not fix citation loss in ordinary prose. The live Docker/Muse run and image build below are complete. Phone/HAP tests, full engine suite, deployment, and independent review remain unverified. Keep this draft until the applicable review and runtime gates are satisfied. Revert this commit to restore previous presentation behavior; no data migration is involved.


## Live verification — 2026-11-09

Built the complete upstream Dockerfile at PR head `aade5ab65716dc035e5edf52668eb4acc52909bd` (APT mirror set to deb.debian.org), then ran Nullius’s unchanged agent.search/v1 kit with `meta/muse-spark-1.3-contributor` through OpenRouter. The existing ACP adapter was retained; the test explicitly selected the candidate image. No catalogue proof or original run result was updated.

- Initial three-check run: **find-source passed**, **disambiguate passed**, **follow-reference ended with HTTP 400: Provider returned error** before producing its final answer. This is a 2/3 initial run, not a clean 3/3 suite.
- Retried only follow-reference once using the standard shard selector, with the same candidate image/model: **passed**.
- All three completed checks passed all four verifier conditions: answer, exact source URL, evidence, and ordered HTTP retrieval. The reference check also retrieved the intermediate page before the final source.
- Therefore every search check has a live passing result with this candidate, with one provider-error retry explicitly retained. The initial run remains failed 2/3; results were not merged or rewritten to hide the interruption.

These are real model calls and real Docker agent/tool/fixture execution, not replay or a scripted backend. This bounded kit result does not establish public-web GAIA performance, phone behavior, or general prose citation provenance.

Closes #698

## What

A task's selected project directory was stored but dropped before the Bridge opened its WorkSwarm session. File operations could consequently use a generated task folder instead of the selected directory.

Forward `Task.project_path`, select or create the native WorkSwarm project, and pass its binding during session creation. Include the normalized directory in scope ownership so a continuation cannot reuse a session from another project. Preserve projectless identities and `work` mode; refuse incompatible existing bindings.

## Validation

- Reproduced the forwarding failure against unmodified main `fc08933b4a3fa1ac5e95f9843afe7a756ddda42d`, without a model call.
- 105 WorkSwarm tests passed, including forwarding, same/different-project reuse, restart, rotation, missing-directory rejection, binding drift and lost-create-response recovery.
- 37 existing conversation and task-clear tests passed.
- Contributor guide Node command: 2,658 passed, two skipped, no failures, with CI-pinned test dependencies.
- Docker native API check passed: explicit directory binding, unchanged `work` mode, same-project session reuse and different-project isolation. The v0.1.8 runtime used the changed product service source read-only, with networking disabled and no model calls.
- `git diff --check` passed.

[Reproduction, commands, limits and visual evidence](docs/developer_guide/evidence/project-workspace-binding/README.md).

## Risk and limits

Explicit project requests now register/select a WorkSwarm project and require an existing absolute directory. An existing project in another mode is rejected rather than modified. The directory becomes part of session identity; switching projects starts a distinct session. Projectless sessions retain their existing identities.

No prompts, model settings, tools, vendored execution sources or execution modes were changed. Live model-driven file editing and HarmonyOS device behavior were not tested. This PR does not claim improved answer accuracy.



## Main branch integration

Conflict resolved in `5753a89b61f47187fe7a0f6c069d7f49acef6cf5` by merging main `3088fdf9f8b0ae16eacecdaf842addd7d6e893bc`. Both project binding and upstream runtime-generation tracking are retained. The new regression verifies project-preserving reconnect and durable runtime-generation acquisition.

Post-merge validation: 65 adapter/project/unload tests and 49 project/conversation tests passed (the groups overlap). A broader discovery had 116 passes and one launcher-policy error because the local environment lacks the newly required installed WorkSwarm runtime overlay. This prerequisite was not bypassed. CI is rerunning on the new head.

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
Run selection is now durable and enforced at the host boundary. Requested configuration revision, resolved instructions and exact selected tool references survive duplicate/reopen; an empty set stays empty. Production Registry composition records pending admission and seals before any execution provider. A replacement Harness cannot expand model declarations or call hidden tools, and current host permission/enablement is rechecked at async and blocking-worker dispatch admission.

The shared types and scoped Store/Manager/Agent Service readers have one schema owner. Caller `selection_intent` is a versioned immutable input; server-policy `configuration_intent` is a separate first-admitted output. Default fingerprints remain compatible. Pinned-version failure, conflicting sealing and unavailable selected configuration fail without switching to current definitions. ModelCall remains a zero-tool host fast path: explicit selected instructions enter its actual system message, while its previous default request stays unchanged. The default registered Core consumes its selected prompt/declarations and rechecks ask_user authority at the existing backend question boundary.

`CurrentToolAuthority` provides synchronized global, owner and full-RunScope epochs. Scope denial removes model-visible declarations and blocks even a permissive provider; re-enablement does not restore an old live lease. Already-dispatched known results stay truthful. Cloud wires the existing real scoped Office permission ceiling into HostAPI; clarification is a distinct exact internal capability. This is not C3 Allow/Ask/Deny or a durable permission database.

Current head: `19870cae1ff909c0eb0b660892854c10dd9c6488`; production code is identical to reviewed `7ab3567cc98686c79f17cd65fabd2d217e6cf872`. Target: `codex/architecture-foundation`; latest incorporated foundation: `83494b97`. No C1/C3/C4/C5 unmerged implementation is included. Phone v35 is separate and contains none of this C2 activation/schema work.

Validation: **143 tests passed, zero failures/errors/skips**, Python 3.11.2, 4.997 s wall including imports. Real Registry/Router/Agent Service/Manager/file-backed SQLite/HostAPI participate; inference, ordinary tools and independent loops are explicitly controlled. Default-Core checks use the fixed read-only pinned-source checkout. Cases cover A/date vs B/zero, new-agent-after-startup, pending/sealed reopen, duplicate after edits, exact versions, schema/hidden-call injection, actual AS executor queue revocation, sibling isolation, started result preservation, ModelCall instructions and question revocation. The real question-inflight regression was red (new Q1 after revocation), then green (zero new interaction), with original answer/Stop/wrong-R cases preserved. A host-disabled counterexample lets the permissive provider enter once; restoring enforcement gives zero entry. Full module list/source-tree evidence is retained in the control log and summarized in docs/verification/run-selection-records.md. Independent QA completed against exact 7ab production. The original target Python 3.13.16 run retained 180 executions with three old-fixture errors; all other stages and independent public/no-Core probes passed. The new read-only target-image command (`python -m server.agent_service.selection_compatibility --database <same-state-db>`) reports capability `dm.run-selection.v1`; new-target/old-target and corrupt-format refusal are tested. items.body:
Selecting EARLY versus LATER within one product session previously changed only routing and produced no selected-quote distinction in model input. This core slice adds optional canonical QuoteSelection(source_submission_id, part, expected_sha256), with no submitter-supplied source text, owner, room or S/R. The expected digest is SHA-256 of the exact authoritative selected UTF-8 text, not a preview or a permission token.

Manager owns validation/policy and canonical M identity. Router uses the originating M to choose S. Inside Store's existing BEGIN IMMEDIATE admission transaction, duplicate M is reconciled first; a new M then rechecks the owner-scoped source M/S/R, part, digest and selected text before committing its binding and sealed typed input. A nullable quote_manifest independently binds quote identity, with old rows defaulting to no quote. The run start snapshot carries unchanged user text plus a versioned quote data envelope. Existing HostAPI context.read and direct-model execution consume that same sealed view; Core/HostAPI implementation did not need a second quote path.

The transaction checks rollback, source changes around admission, exact same-M replay/conflicts, concurrent M, parent disappearance and old data. Ask references the original visible text, not an embedded earlier quotation; reply requires a completed answer. Quote plus attachments and competing explicit routes are rejected in this first text-only scope. Current-call owner/read authorization remains required: an M or digest never authenticates a caller, and cross-owner replay/context reads fail. Gateway wire/room/publication code is untouched and legacy quoted wire sends remain disabled. Active-window/paged-history lookup limitations are separately retained in #660.

Execution evidence and open gate:

- Before the instruction to move execution to adx-jiuwen-test-3, all 419 server tests passed, zero skips,43.200s at b933d8c9 on base1ae18423. Those tests used an ephemeral local Docker delivery image, NOT remote gVisor. They include real Runtime, actual Core/HostAPI and direct ModelGateway over real loopback HTTP with controlled providers, plus existing ask_user/Stop/tool denial/attachments/Office regressions.
- The branch is now rebased on architecture f25f53595279742c5e7e812127f395db1ebc8426 (#661/#662 included). Integrated server execution on that head has NOT run. Per user direction, no further local server/test was started; the lead owns remote gVisor execution and independent review. Static Python parsing and diff checks pass.
- The previous long-lived own dm-room-637-independent QA container was identity-checked, manifest-frozen, stopped and retained with state plus a hashed offline copy. Other live endpoints/devices were untouched.

Implementation is split into admission, Runtime consumption and consistency-hardening commits. docs/specs/authoritative-quote-input.md describes the contract; docs/verification/authoritative-quote-input.md names the exact evidence source and a remote handoff command. This is an initial reviewable draft, not a remote-pass, production quote-wire or phone acceptance claim. Full wire alias/opaque ingress correlation remains later work.

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
The frozen phone quote selector currently has no safe published-reference read operation. This accepted first slice adds Gateway-owned read-only resolution for exact published {room_id,message_id} and legacy {task_id,part} selectors. It calls public Runtime.read_submission with the verified owner and published M, checks M/S/R, part eligibility and exact authoritative text, and returns only the selected text plus checked identities.

Unknown/restarted-away mappings fail unavailable; cross-owner/principal/room and client authority fields fail before history access. Modern/legacy selectors of the same source are aliases. EARLY remains the selected source even when the frozen caller's follows points at a later turn. No ID-prefix decoding, other component private state, lease, source-version token or quote submission is introduced. Only projection.py gains an additive public read operation; shared Gateway dispatch, navigation/protocol, Runtime/Router/Manager/Store and their types remain unchanged. The branch is rebased onto merged #640. Production quoted task.create stays UNSUPPORTED.

Validation at integrated architecture base 1ae184231f49f5791f1bc534f3f06574b78b4978 (includes #640): all 55 Gateway UT and 53 Gateway ST pass, zero skips (0.284s and 14.445s) in the pinned delivery image. This includes 11 new UT and 7 new ST covering real public Runtime/SQLite publication, same-S source/part distinction, wrong scope, missing source, facade reopen with empty projection, authorized non-home room publication from public history, substituted history identities/text/type, UTF-8 output limits, rich-reader field isolation and disabled production submission. Resolver reads add zero model/classifier work. Existing artifact WSS/Core, attachment, date, replay, disconnect and authority revocation regressions also pass with their controlled providers.

Independent review found an admitted-state gap; a real Runtime test pauses on_admitted before claim and reproduced RED, then passed after accepting admitted asks. Replies still need a completed authoritative answer and published result. The updated code was freshly rerun; peer review of the fix was requested but the team tool hit its thread limit, so no independent fixed-head approval is claimed.

Authorization is the existing trusted AccountAuthority call path, not construction of a VerifiedScope dataclass. Revocation observed before request authorization denies; later revocation can race with reads/admission; delivery reauthorization can suppress a response without undoing acceptance. The output has a64KiB UTF-8 ceiling, but the unchanged history facade reads the full record first; no bounded-allocation claim is made. Publication is transient and is not rebuilt by guessing IDs after restart. This is a component read slice, not phone quote acceptance or atomic admission. #657's proposal is separately revised to remove a mandatory lease, settle retry/alias/follows correlation, and leave atomic sealing plus both execution paths for later owner-approved work.

Add an explicitly configured, single-grant QA AccountAuthority and synchronous Office permission provider. The provider checks a private grant file on every decision, binds the credential to a configured owner, principal, binding and dedicated workspace, and fails closed for expiry, revocation, invalid configuration and non-boolean permissions. ## 问题

读屏在每个返回按钮后面多停一个「图片」节点，同一个控件被念两遍；心上事列表里每条记录后面也一样多一个停靠点。父节点已经有可读名，缺的是把纯装饰的箭头图标移出无障碍树：

- `pages/A2uiHome/components/common/A2uiButtonView.ets` 的 `shape === 'back'` 分支：`Button` 内 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))`，父 `Button` 已有 `.accessibilityText(label || '返回')`。该组件被 6 个返回按钮复用（`ComposioAuthPage`、`HomePage`、`TrainPresalePanel`、`ConfigPage`、`A2uiHome/Index.ets`、`SharedWaterfallCard`）。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimDetailPage.ets` 的 `Header()`：44×44 返回 `Stack` 内 `Image(icon_back)`，父 `Stack` 已有 `.accessibilityText('返回心上事列表')`。
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/BimHomePage.ets` 的 `@Builder RecordRow`：记录行尾部的装饰箭头（`.rotate({ angle: 180 })`），父 `Row` 已有拼接的 `.accessibilityText(...)`，**每条记录**都多一个「图片」停靠点。

## 修法

三处 `Image($r('app.media.icon_back'))` 各追加 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，父节点的 `accessibilityText`、`onClick`、尺寸、颜色、事件一律不动。`accessibilityLevel('no')` 只把组件自身移出无障碍树（`'no-hide-descendants'` 才隐子树），与本文件族既有写法一致（`WaterfallTaskOverlay.ets` 的 `statusIcon()` 等）。

## 可达性

- 共享返回按钮：6 个调用点都在 release 的 `build()` 路径上（见上方文件列表），无 debug 闸门。
- 心上事：`HomePage.onOpenBim` → `A2uiHome/Index.openBimRoot()`（`showBimPage = true`）→ `BimSpace()` → `BimHomePage`（列表）→ `onOpenRecord` → `openBimDetail()` → `BimDetailPage`。`isDebugBuild` 只作用于 sentinel mock 与 feed 调试，不作用于这两个页面。

## 测试

先红后修：测试 `tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs` 读真 `.ets` 源码，按块定位到每个具体节点，断言图标的修饰链带 `.accessibilityLevel('no')`，并断言父节点的可读名/点击不被改坏。

```text
# pristine 3802d46e（只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs
✖ the shared back button hides its decorative arrow (1.335359ms)
✖ the heart-things detail back control hides its decorative arrow (0.743464ms)
✖ the heart-things record row hides its decorative arrow (0.908886ms)
ℹ tests 5
ℹ pass 2
ℹ fail 3
✖ failing tests:
✖ the shared back button hides its decorative arrow (1.335359ms)
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: the A2uiButtonView back button: its Image child at line 91 has no .accessibilityLevel('no'), so the screen reader announces a bare image right after the wrapper label
✖ the heart-things detail back control hides its decorative arrow (0.743464ms)
```

```text
# 修复后
$ node --test tests/unit/back-button-icon-a11y.test.mjs
ℹ tests 5
ℹ pass 5
ℹ fail 0
```

基线不动（`check-a11y` 只统计未命名点击目标，隐藏装饰子节点不改变计数）：

```text
$ node scripts/check-a11y.mjs
Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.
```

基于 `3802d46e`，3 个生产文件 `+3/−1`，加 1 个测试文件。

Fixes #449

## 问题

英文设备的用户走的是同一条云端连接状态链路，但连接横幅的文本与动作按钮都是硬编码中文：读屏聚焦横幅时整块播报未翻译的中文状态（例如「正在连接云端…」），英文用户看到的按钮是「重新加载」「正在连接」「立即重试」，既读不懂当前状态，也不知道按下去会重连。连接链路其余文案都经 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` / `digitalmateBusinessError()` 收敛成可读句子，唯独这一处把中文字面量直接渲染进 `Text` 与 `Button`，没有任何语言分支。

## 修法

- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets`：`digitalmateConnectBanner()` 与 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 增加可选 `language` 参数（默认 `'zh-CN'`），`en` 开头（`/^en\b/i`）输出英文，其它语言逐字节维持现状；新增 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel(kind, language)` 统一产出三个按钮文案（`reload` / `connecting` / `retry`）。`digitalmateBusinessError()` 的透传分支保持原样——服务端业务原文不翻译。
- `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`：组件字段初始化器里取一次 `digitalmateClientContext().language`（不进 `aboutToAppear`，既有 banner fixture 不受影响）（仓库现有唯一语言入口，与 `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets` 同源），把该语言传给横幅文案、`accessibilityText` 与三个按钮文案；显隐条件、重试逻辑、样式与 5 秒 slow 定时器不变。
## 未纳入本 PR

- 客户端自有文案经调用方传入、仍未英文化的一批：`'正在同步云端会话…'`（会话加载中）与网关恢复态的两句 `'正在恢复云端连接…'` / `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试连接'`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 的 `beginGatewayRecover()` 与横幅入参）。这句是客户端自有文案，但走的是 `digitalmateBusinessError()` 的业务消息透传分支，因此本 PR 的 `language` 参数管不到它——英文设备在这一态仍会看到中文状态，按钮已是英文 `Reload`。
- 本轮不改的原因：该文件同时被多项未合入 PR 占用（本 PR 开题时抓取的占用快照命中 `#334`、`#391`、`#441`、`#474`、`#481`、`#555`），改它会与这些 PR 直接冲突。
- 已建独立 tracking issue 跟进：见 #564（含改法、验收标准与前置占用清单）。
- 范围确认：`#563` 的生产代码只改 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 与 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets`，不碰 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`。

- **二次本地化兜底（F1）**：调用方会先把错误本地化成中文再存进 `this.error`（`pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets`、`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`），横幅再以英文渲染时原本会原样透出中文。现在 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 持有本模块**自有文案**的 zh→en 对照（10 条 + `正在重新连接云端（第 N 次）…` 正则），英文路径先查表再走正则；`state === 'open'` 的业务透传分支只在命中自有文案时才替换，**服务端 / 模型原文照旧原样透传**。英文路径同时把 `证书|certificate|SSL|TLS` 提到 `网络|…` 之前，避免 TLS 失败被报成「网络不可用」；中文路径的判定顺序一字未改。
- 共 2 个生产文件，不动 `cloud/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets`（被 #481 占用），不碰 `cloud-adapter/.../CloudMarkdown.ets`（#547 / #403）。

## 可达性

1. `entryability/EntryAbility.ets` 冷启动 `loadContent('pages/A2uiHome/Index')`。
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets` 的 `CloudConversationBody()` 在 `cloudBackend === 'digitalmate'` 时渲染 `DigitalMateConversationBinding`；该后端是默认值（`resources/rawfile/app_config.example.json` 的 `"cloudBackend": "digitalmate"`）。
3. `DigitalMateConversationBinding` 的 `build()` 里 `if (this.state !== 'open' || this.error)` 渲染本组件，而 `state` 初值为 `'closed'`——冷启动第一帧横幅必然出现；断开、超时、重连中也走同一分支。
4. 全屏会话页 `pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` 也直接使用同一组件，两个入口共用这份文案。

## 测试

先红后修：`tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs` 把 `DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 去掉类型后在 vm 里**真执行**（不复制实现），并静态守卫组件装配。

```text
# 红基线 eb1408de（= f69d6335 + 只有测试）
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs
✖ every Chinese sentence the module emits is translated when it is fed back in English
✖ a caller that localises the error first still gets English from the banner, and server text is untouched
✖ the four stored Chinese errors still read in English when a caller pre-localised them
ℹ tests 10 · pass 7 · fail 3
```

```text
# 最终 head 5de0ad69
$ node --test tests/unit/connection-banner-bilingual.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-ux.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-connection-banner.test.mjs
ℹ tests 21 · pass 21 · fail 0 · skipped 0
```

基线不动：`node scripts/check-a11y.mjs` → `Files with unnamed tap targets: 28 known, 0 new or worse, 0 stale.`

残留（未验证，不当成已验证）：英文串若再被喂回 `digitalmateUserFacingError()` 会被二次分类——`'Reconnecting to the cloud (attempt 2)…'` 含 `econn`（Reconnecting 的子串）、`'Secure connection failed…'` 含 `network`，都会被判成网络失败。当前路径不可达（banner 的 `connecting` 分支直接返回，不做二次分类），中文侧不受影响，故本 PR 不改；但不视为「已验证安全」。

未验证（不伪造）：真机 TalkBack / VoiceOver 的实际朗读与 `.accessibilityGroup(true)` 下的焦点顺序——沙箱没有 HarmonyOS 设备，只做了源码级执行断言。另有一处新增调用语境：本 PR 让组件在**字段初始化器**里调用 `digitalmateClientContext()`，即仓库里第一次在 UI 构造期调用 `i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()`（其余 6 个调用点都在提交/发送路径），其构造期异常行为未经真机验证。

## 回归护栏（变异验证）

`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` 的每一处英文分支都有断言钉住，删掉即变红（每条都实跑过）：`digitalmateEnglish()` 恒 false → 3 红；只删 `digitalmateConnectionActionLabel('reload'|'connecting'|'retry', language)` 的 language 实参 → 各 1 红；只删 `.accessibilityText(...)` 的 language → 1 红；字段初始化器硬编码 `'en'` 或 `'zh-CN'` → 各 1 红；英文证书优先分支 `if (english && …)` 改成 `if (false && …)` → 1 红；open 态英文改走通用映射 → 1 红。

最后一条对应断言 `a server business message in the open state stays verbatim even when it mentions a mapped keyword`：open 态的服务端业务原文即便含 `网络` / `超时` / `证书` 等被映射的关键词，英文下也必须逐字节原样透传（本 PR 只翻译模块自有的 10 条规范句与重连模板，不翻译服务端与模型输出）。

## 范围

基于 `main@f69d6335`，3 文件 `+558/−22`：生产 2 个文件 `+97/−22`（`DigitalMateConnectionUx.ets` `+84/−17`、`DigitalMateConnectionBanner.ets` `+13/−5`），测试 1 个文件 `+461/−0`。Reviewer 最终 delta 评审：**93/100，`Scored on 5de0ad69`**。
