## What

The composer attachment strip announced its two controls in Chinese only, so TalkBack on an `en` device read 「report.pdf，上传失败」 and 「移除附件 report.pdf」. The two announcements now follow the existing device-language value:

- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` — new pure helpers `composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` and `composerFileActionAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (plus `attachmentLanguageIsEnglish`). zh strings are the exact strings that were inline before; `en*` gets `, upload failed` / `, uploading` / `, uploaded` and `Cancel upload ` / `Remove attachment `.
- `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/ComposerFileStrip.ets` — both `.accessibilityText(...)` calls now use the helpers with `this.language = digitalmateClientContext().language` (`model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:14`, the value #425/#429 already use). No new module, dependency, permission, server call or locale framework.

Fixes #437

## Reachability (release path)

1. `resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:3` → `pages/A2uiHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:1029` `@State private cloudBackend: string = 'workswarm'` (shipped default) → `:8896` `HomePage({ … cloudChat: true (':8928') … })`.
3. `pages/A2uiHome/components/HomePage.ets:1192` `this.CloudComposerFiles(...)` inside `if (this.cloudChat)` (`:1191`).
4. `HomePage.ets:980` `CloudComposerFiles` → `:981` `ComposerFileStrip({ files: this.cloudFiles, … })`.

No constant `false`, no debug flag, no dead branch: `cloudBackend` defaults to `'workswarm'`, `cloudChat` is set to `true` by the page, and none of the touched files references `isDebugBuild`.

## Test: red → green → mutation

- **Red** `cbc93c7` (test only, +89) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 0 / fail 5`, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: FilePresentation.ets must expose composerFileStatusAnnouncement(name, status, language)` (and the same for `composerFileActionAnnouncement`).
- **Green** `716523a`: `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`. Test file byte-identical: `git diff --stat cbc93c7 716523a -- tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/', upload failed'/'，上传失败'/" digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/FilePresentation.ets` →
  `ℹ tests 5 / pass 4 / fail 1` with
  ```
  AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal:
  + actual - expected
  + 'report.pdf，上传失败'
  - 'report.pdf, upload failed'
  ```
  restored → `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`.

## Content anchoring (no line numbers)

Each assertion finds its element by the function name or the call text, never by a line number — adding or removing an unrelated line cannot turn it red. Example from the wiring test:

```js
assert.ok(strip.includes(call),
  'ComposerFileStrip.ets must announce through ' + call + '…), not an inline Chinese-only string');
const start = strip.indexOf(call);
assert.match(strip.slice(start, start + 200), /this\.language|digitalmateClientContext\(\)\.language|language\)/,
  'the ' + call + '…) call must pass the device language');
```

One assertion block per control: the status announcement (zh and en) and the cancel/remove announcement (zh and en), plus one for the strip wiring.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical: the combined CJK string-literal multiset of `FilePresentation.ets` + `ComposerFileStrip.ets` is **12 literals on `main` and 12 on the branch, and the two multisets are identical** — the same strings moved from the component into the pure module. No Chinese literal was edited or retyped.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/composer-attachment-announcements.test.mjs` — red, green and mutation as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1809 tests / 1770 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7**, with the same 28 failing files on both sides (baseline measured on the same `04621bb` tree; failing-file set compared).
- Not run: `hvigorw test`, device/emulator — no ArkTS toolchain or screen reader in this environment.

## Notes

- Branch is based on `04621bb`; upstream `main` has since advanced (`ls-remote` showed `9eea155`) and the local fetch of that commit did not complete from this sandbox, so a rebase may be needed before merge.
- Supersedes nothing; the file pair is touched by no open PR (`FilePresentation.ets`, `ComposerFileStrip.ets`). `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (owned by #434) is not touched.

## What

Three interactive controls in the CloudHome chat header are drawn as a bare glyph or a bare icon with no accessible name, so a screen reader announces the character or "image" instead of the action:

| Control | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| back chevron | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731` `Text('‹')` → announced as "‹" | `.accessibilityText('返回')` |
| session list | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1752` `Image($r('app.media.ic_session_fold'))` → announced as "image" / "图片" | `.accessibilityText('会话列表')` |
| queue-edit close | `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2234` `Text('×')` → announced as "×" (multiplication sign) | `.accessibilityText('退出编辑')` |

One coherent defect class — *(i) icon-only / glyph-only control without accessible text* — one surface (the cloud chat page), one file changed. No layout, colour, size or interaction change; the visible glyphs are byte-identical.

`Fixes #433`

## Reachability (release path, hop by hop)

1. `digitalmate/entry/src/main/resources/base/profile/main_pages.json:6` registers `pages/CloudHome/Index`.
2. `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:363` `CLOUD_CHAT_ROUTE_URL: string = 'pages/CloudHome/Index'` routes to it.
3. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:2572` `if (!this.contentOnly) { this.Header() }` — the header renders on every normal chat open.
4. `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1728` `Header()` builds `:1731` (back chevron), `:1752` (session list, under `if (this.connectionState() === 'open')` at `:1751`), and `QueueBar` → `:2234` (queue-edit close, under `if (this.editingQueueId && !this.contentOnly)` at `:2231`).

No hop is behind a constant `false`, a debug flag or a dead branch: `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` does not reference `isDebugBuild` at all, and the only conditions on the path are live UI state (`contentOnly`, `connectionState()`, `editingQueueId`).

## Test — red, green, mutation

- **Red** `c86fc69` (test only, +98) on `main` `04621bb`: `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, exit 1, verbatim:
  `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/CloudHome/Index.ets:1731 (the chat-header back chevron) must carry a non-empty accessible name, so a screen reader announces the action instead of the bare glyph or "image"`
- **Green** `7801fb2` (1 file, +3/−1): `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.
- Test file byte-identical between red and green: `git diff --stat c86fc69 7801fb2 -- tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` is **empty**.
- **Mutation check** (mandatory): `sed -i "s/        .accessibilityText('返回')//" …/CloudHome/Index.ets` → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 0 / fail 2`, same assertion as the red run; restored → `ℹ tests 2 / pass 2 / fail 0`.

The test reads the shipped page, finds each control's anchor line, walks its modifier chain up to the balanced `.onClick(` handler and requires a non-empty Chinese `.accessibilityText(...)` label, plus that the three names are distinct. A comment or an unrelated edit in the file cannot satisfy it; a control without its label cannot pass it.

## Chinese output

Byte-identical for every pre-existing string: all 121 distinct CJK string literals in `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets` (158 occurrences) are unchanged on the branch — zero removed or altered. The change only **adds** three labels: `返回` (6 bytes), `会话列表` (12 bytes), `退出编辑` (12 bytes). No English copy was added.

## Checks run

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-chat-accessible-names.test.mjs` — red then green as above.
- Full suite on the branch vs `main` `04621bb`: **1806 tests / 1767 pass / 32 fail / 7 skipped** vs **1804 / 1765 / 32 / 7** — the 28 failing files are the same set on both sides (set difference empty).
- Not run: `hvigorw test` and on-device/emulator runs — this sandbox has no HarmonyOS/ArkTS toolchain, so the accessibility names were verified against the source the compiler consumes, not on a device.

## Non-goals held

No new module, no dependency, no permission, no server change, no locale framework, no change to `AboutYouPage.ets`, `AboutYouRenderer.ets`, `MemoryOverview.ets`, `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets`, `BimDailyReminder.ets`, `A2uiHomeState.ets` or `StatusBadgeView.ets` (all owned by open PRs). The only edited file is `pages/CloudHome/Index.ets`, which no open PR touches at the time of writing.

Fixes #424

## What this ships

The「关于你」memory card now follows the device language for its local copy: 6 category titles, the document `lang`, `<title>`, `<h1>` and the two topbar accessible labels resolve in zh-CN (default, unchanged) and en.

## Red first, then green

- red `4bbe6e9` — test-only commit, `tests/unit/memory-card-bilingual.test.mjs`: **4 fail / 1 pass**, real assertion failures on main `04621bb`:
  - `memoryOverviewCategoryLabel('identity','en-US')` → `'身份与经历'` (expected `'Identity & experience'`)
  - `renderAboutYouDocument('test-token','en-US')` → no `<html lang="en">` (actual: false), still `<title>关于你</title>`
  - `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl('test-token','en-US')` → no `lang="en"`
  - extracted real `setAboutYouOverview()` body from `Index.ets` → sections `[ '身份与经历' ]` (expected `[ 'Identity & experience' ]`)
- green `937b462` — 5/5 pass; `git diff 4bbe6e9 937b462 -- tests/unit/memory-card-bilingual.test.mjs` is empty (test file identical across both commits).

## Change (4 files, +33/−8)

- `memory/MemoryOverview.ets`: `memoryOverviewCategoryLabel(category, language = 'zh-CN')`; `/^en\b/i` → English titles, everything else keeps the current zh.
- `pages/A2uiHome/html/AboutYouRenderer.ets`: `renderAboutYouDocument(token, language = 'zh-CN')` and `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl(token, language = 'zh-CN')`; English emits `lang="en"`, `About you`, `aria-label="Back"`, `aria-label="Refresh overview"`. The zh document is **byte-identical** to main (verified: 33136 bytes == 33136 bytes against `upstream/main`).
- `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:3973` `setAboutYouOverview()`: passes `digitalmateClientContext().language` into the section title at the real call path.
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/AboutYouPage.ets:30`: builds the WebView document URL with the same device language.

## Reachability (no unreferenced module)

- `pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets:3982` (title creation) → `AboutYouSection.title` → `AboutYouPage` → `AboutYouRenderer` `<h2>` per section. The test extracts and executes that real method body, not a copy.
- `pages/A2uiHome/components/AboutYouPage.ets:30` → `buildAboutYouDocumentUrl(token, digitalmateClientContext().language)` → document `lang`, `<title>`, `<h1>`, topbar aria-labels read by TalkBack.
- Locale source is the app's existing validated one: `model/DigitalMateDeviceContext.ets:15` (`i18n.System.getSystemLocaleInstance()`), no new framework or dependency.

## Tests run

- `node --test tests/unit/memory-card-bilingual.test.mjs` → 5 pass / 0 fail.
- `node --test tests/unit/about-you-page-lifecycle.test.mjs` → 7 pass / 0 fail.
- Full CI unit file list: see the run in this PR's checks (`node-ut`); local count will be pasted in the job report, with the same known environment failures as the `04621bb` baseline (missing `typescript`/`playwright` devDependencies).

Not run locally: real-device TalkBack announcement, Playwright/Chromium interaction test (no Chromium in this sandbox — same baseline skip), ArkTS compiler (CI ArkTS Code Check covers it).

## Cuts

Only the local card copy on this surface. The rest of the About You page chrome (update card, public-account flow, MBTI copy) is still zh and is left for a later slice; the model-generated summary/claims are not translated.

## Constraints

One issue, one PR, fresh branch from `main`; no new dependency, no repo metadata, no permission change, no force-push, no merge, no secrets, no prompt/response bodies. Rollback = revert `4bbe6e9..937b462`.

items.body:
## 问题

`chat.final` 的落地路径先解析「这条 final 覆盖哪个分段」，`parseChatFinalSegmentId()` 把四个候选字段塞进 `string[]` 后逐个 `.trim()`。帧是服务端下发的 JSON，`Payload.segment_id?: string` 只是编译期声明；消息 id 在服务端常是整数，`||` 只吞掉 `0`/`''`，非零数字会原样进入数组并让 `.trim()` 抛 `TypeError`。

在 `0fb0456` 上实测：

```
parseChatFinalSegmentId({ segment_id: 42 })        → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
session.apply({event:'chat.final',
  payload:{request_id:'turn', content:'最终回答', stream_message_id: 98765}})
                                                   → TypeError: value.trim is not a function
```

异常发生在帧分发里，被 `CloudConnection` 的 `try/catch` 转成 `onProtocolError('消息处理失败，详见通信日志')`：这条 final 的正文整条丢失，同一轮的 `finishTurn()` 也没执行，用户看到的是通用错误提示而不是回复。

Fixes #410

## 改动

`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudFinal.ets`（+11/−6）：

- 候选值按 `string | undefined` 收集，逐个 `typeof value !== 'string'` 跳过，字符串路径仍 `trim()` 后返回；
- 四个字段都不可用时返回 `''`（表示写到客户端当前分段），不再抛异常；
- 与同文件 `parseChatFinalMode()` 已有的 `typeof raw !== 'string'` 校验保持一致。

不改协议、不改分段选择策略、不改任何网络行为；只是不再让一个可选字段的类型把整条 final 打掉。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs`，**先失败后通过**（`0fb0456` 上 4 条中 3 条失败）：

| 用例 | 断言 |
| --- | --- |
| 数字型 `segment_id` / `stream_message_id` | 返回 `''`，不抛异常 |
| 前一个候选不可用、后一个可用 | 取到 `'m-9'`；`'seg-1'` 原样返回；`'  seg-2  '` 被 trim |
| `parseChatFinalMode` 非字符串 | 仍返回 `''`（回归保护） |
| 带数字 `stream_message_id` 的 `chat.final` | 回复落进气泡、`completed === true`、会话回到 `idle` |

```
node --test tests/unit/cloud-final-segment-id.test.mjs   # 4/4
node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs                  # 517 tests · 514 pass · 3 fail
```

3 条失败是本地缺依赖的既有基线（`Cannot find module 'typescript'` ×2、`'playwright'` ×1，CI 的 `ut.yml` 会安装），与本次改动无关。`CloudFinal.ets` 此前在 `tests/unit` 里没有任何覆盖，这个文件顺带补上。

## 未验证

- 服务端线上是否真的会下发数字型分段 id：仓库内没有服务端代码，无法证实。本 PR 修的是「客户端把可选字段做成硬失败点」这一可复现事实，而不是声称线上已发生。
- 真机渲染与 ArkTS 编译：沙箱无真机与 ArkTS 工具链，由 CI 的 ArkTS Code Check 覆盖。

## 风险与回滚

行为面很小：只有非字符串候选值从「抛异常」变成「跳过」。若服务端确实永远只发字符串，这个改动等价于空操作。回滚只需 revert 这一个 commit。

items.body:
## 问题

最新 main 上，Orbit 设备 ST 的测试 HAP **编译不出来**。

```
.\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
→ COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22 WARN:100}
  Error: Property 'trajectory' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Property 'profilingEnabled' does not exist on type 'ProductionComposer'
  Error: Cannot find name 'OrbitResponse' / 'OrbitRequest'
  Error: Cannot find module '@loop/cloud-adapter'
```

## 根因

`tests/dfx/stability/orbit-device/ComposerHost.ets` 是一个**手写**的 host 类，承载 `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` 从生产 `OrbitHome/Index.ets` **逐字提取**的 `send` / `drainSend` 方法体。

生产代码这阵子给这两个方法加了 trajectory 打点、profiling 开关和 draft 行状态，但 host 没跟着声明。提取是逐字的，所以方法体里引用了 host 上不存在的成员——编译必失败。

这是 main 上的既有缺陷，**与任何新用例无关**。已用未修改的 main（`5d574e36`）直接复现。

## 改动

| 文件 | 改动 |
|---|---|
| `ComposerHost.ets` | 引入并实例化生产 `OrbitTrajectory` 作为 `trajectory`；补 `profilingEnabled`（关闭）、`traceSubmissionId`、`draftNeedsOwnRow`；补 `OrbitRequest`/`OrbitResponse` 导入 |
| `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs` | 拷贝 `OrbitTrajectory.ets` 并在 `orbit/index.ets` 导出；改写 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 的 `'@loop/cloud-adapter'` 别名 |
| `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 两个新守卫 |

### 为什么用真实 `OrbitTrajectory` 而不是空实现

它是纯逻辑类，只依赖 `hilog` 和 `OrbitProtocol` 的计时类型，没有 UI 依赖。用真实实现意味着提取出来的 `send`/`drainSend` 仍然调用**产品本来的**记录器，而不是我在测试里伪造一个。这符合这套 ST 的原则：产品方法逐字执行，测试只补 UI 生命周期。

`profilingEnabled` 设为 `false`，与页面默认值一致，让产品 `send` 走非诊断分支。`traceSubmissionId` / `draftNeedsOwnRow` 也取页面初始值。

### 两个守卫

这次问题的本质是「手写 host 与逐字提取的方法体失配」，而且**只有到真机跑才会发现**。所以补了两个单元守卫：

1. **成员完备性**：提取出的方法体里每个 `this.<member>`，必须能在 host 上解析（`extractSupport` 注入的方法算数）。缺失即报 `ProductionComposer is missing: x, y`。
2. **别名改写**：直接对生成产物断言，任何生成的 `.ets` 都不得残留 `'@loop/'`。这比匹配 prepare 的源码写法可靠。

守卫已验证有效：删掉 `trajectory` 那一行，立刻报
```
AssertionError: ProductionComposer is missing: trajectory
```

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs`（干净 main + 本 commit） | **25/25 通过** |
| 守卫有效性 | 移除 `trajectory` → 报 `missing: trajectory`；恢复 → 全绿 |
| `-CompileOnly -Cases core`（本分支） | **`CompileOnly succeeded`**，`Verified test HAP: SDK runner and all six business case implementations are present.` |
| 生成物别名 | 生成后 `OrbitDeviceContext.ets` 内已无 `@loop` |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |

编译是**实际执行**的，不是推断：本机 hvigor 已跑通，输出见上。

**未做：** 没有在真机跑业务用例（需要 Gateway Bearer，当前环境没有）。本 PR 只修编译，不改任何用例语义。

## 复现

```powershell
# 修复前
git checkout 5d574e36
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → COMPILE RESULT:FAIL {ERROR:22}

# 修复后
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases core
# → CompileOnly succeeded
```

## 与其他 PR 的关系

与 #296（新增 #233/#278、#241 的 ST 回归用例）**相互独立**，可分别合并。#296 也包含同样的编译修复（否则它自己的新用例也编不过）；本 PR 先合入后，#296 可以 rebase 掉这部分。

items.body:
## 关联 Issue

- #233（`==` 标记泄漏，已由 #257 修）与 #278（等号比较被吞，已由 #269 修）
- #241（停止按钮无响应，已由 #268 修）

三个 issue 的修复都已在 main 上。本 PR **不改产品代码**，只把这三处行为补成设备级 ST 回归，避免以后同一个正则或同一处任务定位再退化。

## 做了什么

新增两条 Orbit 真实业务 ST 用例，并保持既有用例行为不变。

### `markup` — 等号比较与高亮标记解析（#233 / #278）

- 把**生产**的 `CloudMarkdown.ets` / `CloudMath.ets` 一起编译进独立 ST HAP，断言直接调用 `parseInline` / `parseMarkdownTable`，而不是复制一份正则到测试里（复制出来的正则会和生产实现漂移，正是这两个 issue 的成因）。
- 先要求模型原样回显一行混合文本，再对**该任务实际返回的回复**做断言：
  1. 每个带空格的比较片段（`a == b`、`if x == 0`）必须原样保留在可见文本里；
  2. 比较不得被渲染成 highlight（这正是 #278 里操作数被删掉的原因）；
  3. 紧贴文字的 `==标记==` 仍然高亮，且原始 `==标记==` 不残留在气泡文本里（#233 的症状）；
  4. 表格单元格路径同样成立：`` `a == b == c` `` 保持字面量，裸 `==25%==` 仍高亮。
- 不写死期望字符串：断言遍历回复中**实际出现**的比较片段，模型多说或少说不会被误判成通过。

### `stop` — 停止正在运行的任务（#241）

- 用 `extractRuntimeMethods` 从 `OrbitTaskRuntime.ets` **逐字提取** `topLevelTaskId` / `stopTarget` / `stopTask`，包进 `OrbitStopTarget`，仅补 `current` 与 `client`。停哪个任务、发什么请求，全部是生产代码。
- 真实流程：提交一条长任务 → 要求它此刻仍是 `pending`/`running`/`waiting` → 经生产 `stopTarget` 算出目标 → 发真实 `task.cancel` → 在同一预算内观察到**同一个 task** 变成 `cancelled`。
- 明确失败而非静默通过：`NOT_ACTIVE`、`READ_ONLY_ROOM`、`STOP_TARGET_MISMATCH`、`NO_CANCEL_SENT`、`STOP_IGNORED`、`CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED`。任务先跑到 `completed` 会被判 `STOP_IGNORED`，不会因为"反正结束了"算过。

### 配套改动

- `orb-rst-scenes.mjs`：注册两个新 key。两条新用例**不进** `all` / `smoke` / `core`，需显式 `-Cases markup,stop`；隔离规则改成按用例名判断，不再靠数组位置。
- `prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs`：新增 `extractRuntimeMethods`（源码结构变化即抛错，不静默降级），并把解析器与 `OrbitStopTarget` 纳入生成清单与 `source-manifest.json`。
- `LiveBusiness.test.ets`：`submit()` / `waitTask()` 增加 `untilActive` 分支，让用例能观察运行中的任务，同时仍正确收尾自己的 task trace。
- `run-orbit-device-st.ps1`：HAP 符号门禁补上两个新用例名（原先只校验六条）。
- `orbit-st-report-view.mjs`：补阶段中文名与用例标题，报告里不再显示裸 key。
- `nightly.yml`：`st_cases` 说明同步。
- `README.md`：用例表、选择器说明、以及**每条用例的真实通过条件**。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` | 28 条，26 通过，2 失败 |
| 失败项 | `native stderr warnings…` / `native nonzero exit…` |
| 失败原因 | 本机沙箱禁止 `child_process.spawnSync` 捕获输出（`EPERM`），与本次改动无关：这两条用例及其依赖的 `runNative`（`scripts/orbit-st-tools.mjs`）在 main 上均未改动 |
| `scripts/prepare-orbit-device-st.mjs --compile-only` | 通过，27 个源文件，`OrbitStopTarget.ets` / `CloudMarkdown.ets` 均生成 |
| 生成物语法 | 用 SDK 自带 TypeScript 解析器全量解析 `.ets`，无语法错误 |
| `git diff --check` | 通过 |
| CI `node-ut` | **success**（含 `tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs` 全量 28 条，含本次新增断言） |
| CI `ArkTS Code Check` | **success** |
| CI `hypium-ut` | skipped（仓库变量 `ENABLE_HYPIUM_UT` 未开启，与本次改动无关） |

**未完成、不能算通过：**

- 本机真实 HAP 编译未跑成：hvigor 在 `C:\Users\qq567\.hvigor` 写缓存、并在 `node_modules\@ohos\hvigor` 建符号链接，本机沙箱分别报 `EPERM mkdir` 和 `EPERM symlink`（后者即 WinError 1314）。**CI 也没有跑 HAP 编译那条路**（`hypium-ut` skipped），所以 ST 工程的 ArkTS 编译门禁**仍未真正通过**；生成物只做了 TypeScript 语法解析。
- 两条新用例**从未在真实后端跑过**。`all` / `smoke` / `core` 里没有它们，Nightly 也不会自动跑到，需要显式 `-Cases markup,stop` 并配好 Gateway Bearer 与设备。
- 因此本 PR 不宣称 #233/#278/#241 的 ST 回归"已验证通过"，只提供可执行的回归用例与明确失败判据。跑通后再补真实回执。

## 复现

```powershell
# 离线断言
node tests/unit/orbit-device-st.test.mjs

# 生成 + 编译（需要可用的 DevEco 与符号链接权限）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -CompileOnly -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"

# 真实运行（需要 ST_DEVICE_ID / ST_ORBIT_URL / ST_ORBIT_BEARER）
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\run-orbit-device-st.ps1 -Run -Cases 'markup,stop' -OutputDirectory "$env:TEMP\ST-IssueCases"
```

## 说明

- 提交内容只有上述 8 个文件，未包含签名材料、本地配置或凭据。
- `markup` 与 `stop` 跑通后会各自留下真实通过记录，届时再考虑是否纳入默认套件；本 PR 不预先放宽或收紧既有五条用例。

## 关于 PR 来源

本 PR 与 #294 是同一提交（`c6e0812f`）。#294 从私有 fork 发起，CI 的 `Download source snapshot` 用 base 仓库 token 去取 fork 的 tarball 返回 404，两个门禁只跑了收尾步骤就失败，实际未验证任何代码。改为从本仓库分支 `test/st-issue-regression-cases` 发起后，tarball 走 `github.repository`，两个门禁均已真实执行并通过。#294 已关闭。

## Summary

Adds a Debug-only direct-connect path for self-hosted Orbit and an English zero-to-running deployment guide.

## Changes

- Parse `orbit.direct` / `orbit.directToken`, require a Debug build, and validate a `wss://` endpoint with no credentials, fragment, or extra query parameters.
- Skip Gateway session activation, credential recovery, and quota probing in direct mode. OrbitHome uses the direct Bearer configuration; the local DigitalMate account login is still required.
- Keep Release behavior unchanged: direct settings are ignored and Gateway authentication is still required.
- Add unit coverage for direct config, startup gating, and build-time config validation.
- Add `docs/developer_guide/deploy-own-orbit.md`, covering image build, single-host Docker Compose with native `ORBIT_ACCESS_TOKEN`, TLS/WSS, DigitalMate Debug setup, acceptance checks, troubleshooting, and a Kubernetes path for the current test cloud.
- Add the guide to the developer-guide index.

## Validation

- Focused Node tests: 141 passed across `orbit-config`, `orbit-gateway-auth`, `sync-app-config`, `startup-presentation`, `gateway-cloud-ui`, `about-you-page-lifecycle`, and `account-worker-lifecycle`.
- HarmonyOS build: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL` (unsigned because this checkout has no signing config).
- The Kubernetes manifest in the guide parses as one PVC, one Deployment, and one Service.

## Notes

- `directToken` is a Debug-only test secret. Release builds ignore direct mode.
- The Kubernetes example creates an independent `orbit-direct` Deployment/Service/PVC and does not modify the existing `/orbit-profiling` route.
- No visual UI change; no screenshots. No runtime deployment is included in this PR.

recent_closed_unmerged.author: HugoXK
recent_closed_unmerged.body: ## What this fixes Reply bubbles could print unresolved tool-protocol payloads verbatim, e.g. ``` 好的，<|DSML|native_read_source {"path":"attachment-1"}|> ``` Three client-side text paths had no filter at all: `CloudSession.flush()` (`+=` on every stream delta), `applyFinalAnswer()` (`target.text = content`), and `applyHistory()` (rebuilds bubbles from stored raw text, so leaked history showed up again after a cold start). This PR adds the last line of defence: whatever the server does, the user only sees natural language. Fixes #395. Root cause of the original report (unregistered/unexecuted tool, DSML emitted by the model) stays in #330 — this PR does not touch the server, it only guarantees the bubble never renders protocol text. ## How it works New pure module `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudProtocolText.ets`: - `splitToolProtocol(text)` → `{ visible, hold }`: complete `<|...|>` spans are removed; a trailing incomplete span whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix (`dsml`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `endoftext`, `eot_id`, `im_start`, `im_end`) is held back until it closes (or is dropped at end of turn); anything else — a plain `<`, a `` tag, an over-long `<|` that does not look like a protocol marker — is left untouched. - `stripToolProtocol(text)` → `visible` only. `CloudSession` now keeps the unfiltered stream per message in `rawText` and recomputes `row.text` through `stripToolProtocol(raw)` on every delta, so a marker split across deltas never leaks a partial fragment. The same filter is applied to non-streaming `chat.final` (append / replace_turn / patch paths, with `rawText` kept in sync) and to history reconstruction. Nothing else in the session lifecycle changes; no new dependency, no protocol change, no permission change, no prompt/response logging. ## Tests (failing first) `tests/unit/cloud-reply-protocol-text.test.mjs` — 6 cases, loads the real classes through the existing `tests/support/cloud-test-loader.mjs`, no device or backend needed. Red first: before the module existed the suite failed with `ENOENT ... CloudProtocolText.ets`. | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | plain text | `你好，我在。` unchanged | | complete DSML block | dropped | | `<|endoftext|>` | dropped | | `a < b` | preserved | | `` form | dropped | | empty input | empty | Session-level: | Case | Expectation | | --- | --- | | marker split across three deltas | bubble is `好的，我看看文件。` | | trailing unclosed fragment | dropped, bubble is `查完了。` | | non-streaming `chat.final` | bubble is `查一下好的` | | history rebuild after resume | bubble is `这是历史回复` | | ordinary `` tags in text | preserved: `第一段，和 粗体 标签。` | Green after the fix: **193 pass / 0 fail** across `cloud-reply-protocol-text`, `cloud-chat`, `cloud-reply-content`, `cloud-reply-images`, `cloud-page-state`, `cloud-task-recovery`. Full `tests/unit` sweep on this base: 999 pass / 6 fail; all 6 failures are missing local devDependencies (`typescript`, `playwright`) that the `ut.yml` workflow installs, and none of them is touched by this PR. ## Non-goals - No server-side tool parsing/registration work; #330 keeps the root cause. - No new dependencies, no protocol change, no permission widening, no prompt/response content logged. - Tool failures are still reported to the user through the existing error surface — this only stops the raw protocol text from being rendered as body copy. - Pre-existing history rows already stored upstream are not rewritten; they are simply no longer displayed. ## Risk The only failure mode is over-filtering legitimate text. It is bounded to closed `<|...|>` spans and to unclosed tails whose marker name matches a known protocol prefix; every other `<` keeps its behaviour, and two of the six tests pin that down. Rollback is a single revert of three files. Fledge · DigitalMate · Lead · maintained

## 变更内容（文档 + 锚定测试，无行为改动）

- 新增 `docs/product/p2-proactive-audit.md`：以 `04621bb` 为对象，用精确 file:line 审计 P2 每日提醒的构建/调度点、可达性、授权/撤销、以及用户今天看到什么；每条 claim 标注 `[fact] / [inference] / [assumption]`；给出「最小 opt-in + 可关闭」的选项（成本/风险，不是决定）。
- 新增 `tests/unit/p2-proactive-audit.test.mjs`：把文档里 EVIDENCE 块的 42 条引用重新读回真实文件，逐行比对；并把「无生产触发、无设置开关、无 BIM 取消路径、唯一触发是 debug 门」写成针对真实源码的断言。
- **本 PR 不改变任何用户可见行为**：不接提醒触发、不加设置开关、不启用任何通知、不改服务端。

## 结论摘要

- 每日提醒调度 `Index.ets:5499 runDailyBimSentinel(now, scheduleNext = true)` 全仓只有唯一调用点 `Index.ets:5549`，且传 `false` → `Index.ets:5525 scheduleNext(now)` 永不执行。
- 唯一可运行路径是 debug 构建：`Index.ets:5541 if (!this.isDebugBuild)`、`EntryAbility.ets:280 if (!debugBuild) return false;`，debug 标志来自 `AppUpdateService.ets:13 return info.appInfo.debug;`。
- 应用内唯一触发是 `BimHomePage.ets:425 Button('10秒测试 Sentinel')` → `Index.ets:8457` → `Index.ets:5552` → `Index.ets:5561 scheduleDebug(10)`。
- 没有任何用户可见的授权/撤销：`pages/Settings/Index.ets`（94 行）零 `提醒/Reminder/notification` 匹配；`BimDailyReminder.ets` 无 `cancelReminder`（开售提醒有：`SystemOneShotScheduler.ets:105/124`）。
- 今天用户看到什么：发布构建什么也没有；debug 构建请求通知权限后发布**中文**提醒 `检查心上事（测试）` / `10 秒测试提醒`（`BimDailyReminder.ets:105/106`），中英文设备一致；#427 未合入。

## 证据

- **红 `766c14e`**（仅测试，119 行）→ `ℹ tests 5 / pass 3 / fail 2`，exit 1：
  - `the audit cites real source lines and they still say what it says`：`AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: the P2 proactive audit docs/product/p2-proactive-audit.md must exist`
  - `every headline fact carries an explicit confidence marker`：同上（文档缺失）
  - 另 3 个「代码事实」断言在 main 上已经通过——它们锚定的是源码本身，不是文档。
- **绿 `4c991fc`**（2 文件 +243：文档 124 + 测试 119）→ `ℹ tests 5 / pass 5 / fail 0`，exit 0。
- **测试文件在红/绿之间逐字节相同**：`git diff --stat 766c14e 4c991fc -- tests/unit/p2-proactive-audit.test.mjs` 为空。
- **锚定方式（引用断言）**：EVIDENCE 块每行为 `path:line | 该行源码（trim 后）`，测试逐个读回真实文件并 `assert.equal(lines[line-1].trim(), text)`；行号移动、行内容变化都会失败。另有源码结构断言，例如：
  - `assert.equal((index.match(/runDailyBimSentinel\(/g) || []).length, 2, ...)` —— 只有定义 + 唯一调用；
  - `assert.ok(index.includes('if (!this.isDebugBuild) {\n      consumeBimSentinelMockHandoff();'), ...)`；
  - `assert.equal((settings.match(/提醒|Reminder|reminder|notification|Notification/g) || []).length, 0, ...)` —— 设置页不得出现提醒开关；
  - `assert.equal((reminder.match(/cancelReminder/g) || []).length, 0, ...)` —— BIM 无取消路径。

- **未运行**：`hvigorw test`（沙箱无 ArkTS 工具链）、真机/模拟器用例、`hypium-ut`（CI 侧 skip）。

## 风险与回滚

- 结论依赖 `04621bb` 的行号；代码一旦移动，锚定测试会先失败（预期保护）。`git revert` 单个 commit 即可完全回滚。
- 不新增依赖、不新增 `.ets` 模块、不改仓库设置、不改其他账号评论、不记录 prompt/response 正文。

Fixes #412

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`cloudTaskNoticeText()`（`digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/workswarm/CloudTaskNotice.ets`）负责生成 workswarm 任务状态变化的系统通知文本，原来有两处问题：

1. 标题用 `title.slice(0, 24)`、正文用 `slice(0, 220)`，都按 **UTF-16 码元**切。切点落在 emoji 中间时留下孤立代理（`\ud83d`），系统通知渲染成方块。另外标题截断补 `…`、正文截断不补，行为不一致。
2. 正文做了 Markdown 清理（`/[#*`>|]/g`），标题只做 `trim()`，于是 `**`、反引号、`#`、`>`、`|` 原样进入通知标题。

改动：

- 新增 `clipNoticeText(text, limit)`：按码点遍历累计宽度，超限时不切半个代理并追加 `…`。
- 新增 `noticePlainText(text)`：去 Markdown 标记 + 折叠空白 + trim。
- 标题与正文都改走这两个函数；`'未命名会话'` 回退保持不变；长度上限语义仍是 24 / 220。

纯字符串处理层改动，无网络、存储、权限副作用。

## 测试

新增 `tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs`，4 条用例：

| 用例 | `0fb0456` | 本分支 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 标题 23 汉字 + 😀，切点安全且补 `…` | ✖ 尾部 `\ud83d…` | ✔ |
| 正文 219 汉字 + 😀，切点安全且补 `…` | ✖ 尾部 `\ud83d` | ✔ |
| 标题去 Markdown 标记（`**周末** \`计划\``） | ✖ 原样输出 | ✔ |
| 空标题回退 `未命名会话`（防回归） | ✔ | ✔ |

也就是 3 条先红后绿，1 条防回归。

拿到的结果：

- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs` → 4/4 pass
- `node --test tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs tests/unit/cloud-task-notifications.test.mjs` → 20/20 pass
- 回归 `node --test tests/unit/cloud-*.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-*.test.mjs` → **1014 tests / 1011 pass / 3 fail**，3 条与本次改动无关，是环境既有噪声：`typescript` 模块缺失 ×2（`cloud-account-service`、`cloud-embedding`）、`playwright` 缺失 ×1（`cloud-math-renderer`）。

## 没有验证的部分

- 真机 / 模拟器通知栏的实际渲染效果（本环境无 HarmonyOS 设备与 ArkTS 工具链）。结论建立在字符串层面可复核的孤立代理与标记残留上，`tests/unit/cloud-task-notice-text.test.mjs` 就是这条证据的可执行形式。
- 通知分组、去重、投递时序未触碰，行为不变。

## 回滚

两个文件的改动（实现 + 测试），`git revert` 即回到原行为，无需迁移。

## 非目标

不新增通知类型、不改通知触发条件、不改权限、不引入 secret、不改变标题/正文长度上限语义。

recent_merged.body:
## What

DM31-M39 preparation slice for #829: extract the notification read/dismiss version owner and the push subscription owner out of the legacy bridge into `plugins/notifications/`, behind the host ports the DM31-A32 gateway will bind later.

- `plugins/notifications/state.py` — `NotificationState` mark record (legacy payload shape: sha256(principal) id, reads, dismissals, revision), exact-version validators, alias fan-out, history caps, and `NotificationService` (the owning public proxy for `notification.read` / `notification.dismiss`). Selectively adapted from `engine_notifications.py::NotificationState; register` at frozen main `1b67babf`.
- `plugins/notifications/push.py` — `PushNotifier` + `PushSubscriptionService` (the owning public proxy for `push.key` / `push.subscribe` / `push.unsubscribe`), RFC 8291 aes128gcm + RFC 8292 VAPID (12h ES256), endpoint/SSRF scope checks, quiet hours, priming and one-projection-per-notice semantics. Selectively adapted from `engine_push.py` at `1b67babf`.
- `tests/server/plugin_gateway/st/test_m39_boundary.py` — boundary ST (26 tests) over real participants: the two owner modules, a real SQLite mark store, real `push.json` persistence, real RFC 8291/8292 cryptography with an independently written browser-side decrypt check.
- `docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json` — registers the `plugins` root and the `notifications` component (`status: extracting`, `checked: true`, public `notifications.state` / `notifications.push`).
- `.github/ci-gates.json` — server-contracts markers + `minimumTests` 12 → 38.

## Owner boundaries kept

- The owner never sees a legacy EngineService/Bridge: DM record truth stays with Agent Service/Store, queried through the read-only `NotificationSources` port (`standing_records()` is prebuilt once per action, mirroring the legacy closure); the unread-clearing effect goes through `NotificationAcknowledgements.acknowledge` inside the mark-store transaction.
- Scoped vs unscoped asymmetry preserved: mark-time reads are room-scoped (foreign → PermissionError, archived → "This space was removed"); standing checks use unscoped `find_*`, so clearing an alert never depends on current room membership.
- `redact` stays single-owned by the memory domain: injected as a required `redact` callable; the ST uses a controlled named redactor and asserts a password in the person's ask stays off the lock screen.
- No DM session/run records, model/tool calls, or extension wiring in the owner: action binding (`service.extensions`), snapshot-view registration and the store-listener flush loop belong to DM31-A32 / Host lifecycle.
- Legacy `engine_notifications.py` / `engine_push.py` are untouched (read-only sources until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate changes).

## Explicit non-goals (this PR does not switch production)

Blocked-by per the issue — #762 (DM31-M01) and #758 (DM31-A32) — remains true: the legacy bridge keeps serving `notification.*` and `push.*` in production. This PR lands the owning public proxies, their boundary ST and the policy registration; the integration/cutover slice lands with DM31-A32, and the legacy-inventory retirement gate for `engine_notifications` / `engine_push` fires only after that. No production switch is claimed.

## Test evidence

```
python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.plugin_gateway.st.test_m39_boundary
# Ran 26 tests ... OK

python3 -B tools/architecture/manifest.py --check docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json
# 61 owners, 0 exceptions

python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json --root . --format json
# findings: []  (290 files)

python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture -p "test_import_gate.py"
# Ran 6 tests ... OK
```

Coverage of the issue's required cases: normal (read/dismiss exact version + restart persistence, scoped subscribe/unsubscribe roundtrip), failure (stale version, missing source, foreign record → PermissionError with no partial writes, expired/gone subscription pruned, malformed keys/endpoints rejected), concurrency (dismiss v1 never marks newly created v2 read; duplicate provider callback projects once; revision race raises "changed underneath" and preserves the racing writer's mark), and cross-account isolation (no cross-account push with zero subscriptions; principal-scoped mark stores).

recent_merged.body:
Closes #967

## 问题

App 打开云端 WebSocket 后，即使长时间没有任何业务下行也永不主动断开，前台挂起时持续耗电耗流量。

## 方案

`DigitalMateClient` 新增空闲释放机制：

- **阈值**：命名常量 `IDLE_DISCONNECT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000`，与 45s 请求超时、75s 握手超时常量并列（issue 要求命名常量；5 分钟为产品拍板值）。
- **计时**：连接在前台打开即启动空闲计时，每条 `digitalmate.*` 业务下行事件重置时钟。协议心跳是传输层 ping，不经过 `receive()`，天然不会续命；响应端侧自身 snapshot 轮询的回执也不计入（否则内嵌会话页 3s 自轮询会让计时永不触发）。
- **推迟**：存在 pending 请求或进行中任务（`DigitalMateTaskRuntime.hasRunning()` 经注入的 `client.isBusy`）时推迟一个窗口，流式回复与长工具调用期间不会断开。
- **断开方式**：`idleClose()` 递增 socket generation 使 close 回调失效——**不**走 `fail()` / `scheduleRecovery()`，配置保留，状态置为新状态 `'idle'`，与异常关闭明确区分。
- **仅前台**：后台不进入空闲计时、不断开；后台提醒依赖这条常连 socket，在 #460 系统推送落地前保持现状。
- **重连**：回到前台（`setForeground(true)` → `kickReconnect`）；发送下一条消息（`request()` 自动唤起并在握手后排队下发，消息不丢）；回到会话页（`TaskRuntime.connect` 对 `idle` 走唤醒）。
- **UI**：`'idle'` 状态零横幅、零错误文案、无重试按钮；两个会话界面的横幅条件与 `failed` 上报均排除 `idle`；输入框占位在 `idle` 下保持「请输入…」。

## 测试

- 新增 `tests/unit/digitalmate-idle-disconnect.test.mjs`（10 例）：阈值精确触发、事件重置时钟、自轮询回执不续命、pending/isBusy 推迟、后台不断开、前台返回唤醒、request 排队唤醒、kickReconnect 免配置唤醒、命名常量与注入点源码断言。
- `digitalmate-connection-ux.test.mjs` 增加 2 例：idle 无声渲染、两个会话界面源码断言。
- 本地全量 node-ut：2721 tests / 2706 pass / 6 fail，6 个失败与干净基线（stash 后 2709 tests / 6 fail）完全一致，均为本地环境预置失败（Chromium 视觉捕获、AGC SMS 等），与本次改动无关。

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

recent_merged.author: qq56734
recent_merged.body:
## What this fixes

Issue #956 asks for the startup screen to stop showing detailed connection steps, and for failure
and retry detail to stay off the screen. Investigating on latest `main` showed the request is not
about one sentence: **the connection UI accepted free text from the transport and the gateway, and
the only thing between a user and a `wss://` address was a regex.**

This is the fourth round of the same defect (#138 → #136 → #422 → #956). Each earlier round patched
the regex, so the next sentence the team wrote walked straight through it. This PR fixes the pipeline
and adds two suites that fail the build if it regresses.

## What was actually on screen

Measured by running the real `digitalmateUserFacingError` against the real copy tables on `a78b20b1`:

- **9 transport sentences** reached the banner verbatim, including
  `'DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据'` — the team talking to itself — and
  `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'`, which carries an SDK error code and
  an address hint.
- **15 of the gateway's 21 public strings** reached it unchanged. The worst:
  `'云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。'`
  A 64-character operator sentence, under the 80-character length guard that was supposed to catch it.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` printed `snapshot.message` with no sanitizer at all, so one failure showed
  one wording in the banner and a different one in settings.
- The banner printed `'正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…'`.

`CloudHome/Index.ets` still has `'正在连接 ' + endpoint.url + ' …'`, but it is unreachable under the
shipped config (`cloudBackend: "digitalmate"` makes `A2uiHome` render `Blank()` instead of
`CloudConversation`), so it is not touched here.

## The change: a code, one table, one boundary

**1. The failure travels as a code.**

- `DigitalMateTransportReason` in `DigitalMateSocket`: `handshake_timeout`, `handshake_failed`,
  `receive_failed`, `connection_error`, `closed`, `not_started`, `send_failed`, `client_closed`.
  The native error code still goes to `hilog`.
- `DigitalMateClientReason` in `DigitalMateClient`: `not_configured`, `auth_changed`,
  `login_required`, `connecting`, `not_connected`, `cancelled`, `request_timeout`, `send_failed`,
  `session_expired`, `foreground_resume`, `closed`.
- `GatewaySessionSnapshot.failureCode` carries the `GatewayAuthError.code` beside the diagnostic
  `message`, which stays for the log sheet.
- `DigitalMateConnectionUx` gains `CODE_KINDS` (a `Map`: ArkTS rejects untyped object literals)
  mapping both closed code sets to a `DigitalMateFailureKind`, and `digitalmateFailureText` as the
  single place a sentence is written. `TEXT_RULES` survives only so a record saved before this
  change still classifies.

The gateway's public copy loses the operator detail. **Nothing is lost diagnostically:**
`logFailure`/`logAgcDiagnostic` already record target, port, route, prefix, status and code for the
same failure, so the address, the HTTP status, `/auth/*` and the ADX version move to the log instead
of the banner.

**2. The UI has no field for prose.**

- `DigitalMateConnectionBanner` takes `failure` (classified through the one table) and `notice`
  (business prose, only while the transport is open). The `error` prop is gone — that is what makes
  a new sentence structurally unable to reach the screen.
- The line it shows comes from one function, `digitalmateBannerLine`, which the **device suite also
  calls** — so a device assertion covers exactly what a person reads.
- `GatewayAccountPanel` renders `digitalmateFailureText(digitalmateFailureKind(failureCode, message))`
  and no longer prints `snapshot.message`.
- `DigitalMateHome` drops the `gatewayRecoverMessage` field entirely.
- The retry ordinal is gone. `attempt` is still accepted so callers did not change, but it only
  distinguishes "connecting" from "still connecting".

#136 is preserved: a healthy transport with a business failure (`state === 'open'`) still shows its
own readable wording.

**3. Two suites guard it.**

`tests/unit/connection-copy-boundary.test.mjs` (new, **7 tests**, Node):

1. the banner accepts a failure to classify, never a finished sentence;
2. no connection surface renders the gateway diagnostic field;
3. the transport names a reason code instead of writing a sentence;
4. public copy carries no address, HTTP mechanic, `/auth/*`, ADX or test-credential wording;
5. the banner narrates no retry ordinal;
6. every `SAFE_ERROR_CODES` entry has a kind;
7. classifying an already-classified failure does not change its meaning.

`digitalmate/entry/src/test/ConnectionCopyBoundary.test.ets` (new, **8 tests**, registered in
`List.test`):

The same rules asserted in the **real ArkTS runtime**, not a type-stripping VM. It needs no account
and no network — every input is a string — so it runs on the device in CI.

## Review findings fixed in this PR

I reviewed this change as a reviewer and found four problems in my own work, plus one in my own
verification method. All are fixed:

1. **Re-classifying already-classified copy changed its meaning** — real, and introduced by this PR.
   `digitalmateUserFacingError` ran the text rules over its own output. `'没有访问该云端资源的权限'`
   matched no rule, fell to `unknown`, and was redrawn as `'云端连接暂不可用，请重试'`: a permission
   failure reported as a connectivity one. Reachable, because the binding sanitises a message
   (`DigitalMateConversationBinding.ets:529`) and then the banner classifies what it is handed
   (`:628`). Fixed by making the classifier idempotent.
2. **A comment claimed a coverage guard that did not exist.** `CODE_KINDS`'s docblock said "a guard
   test fails when a gateway code has no kind"; nothing read `SAFE_ERROR_CODES`. Guard 6 now does.
3. **A doubled semicolon** (`]];;`) left by the `Record`→`Map` rewrite that ArkTS required.
4. **`unknown` and `config` shared near-identical wording**, so a reader could not tell "we cannot
   tell" from "the gateway is misconfigured". `unknown` now says it does not know.
5. **My first device run reported a false pass.** After injecting a defect, the suite still said
   `Failure: 0`, because hvigor skips the test target when nothing it tracks changed and I read the
   previous `test_result.txt`. Both proof runs are now clean (`.test` removed, `hvigor clean`).

## Verification

### Node

`node --test tests/unit/*.test.mjs`, both worktrees, same dependency set:

| | tests | pass | fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline `a78b20b1` | 2646 | 2637 | 2 |
| this branch | 2648 | 2639 | 2 |

The same two tests fail on both, and they fail on `main` without this branch: an AGC SMS case and
the pinned WebSocket opcode case. **+7 tests, 0 regressions.** Targeted:
`connection-copy-boundary` 7/7, `gateway-auth-client` 41/41, `gateway-session-store` 126/126,
`digitalmate-connection-ux` 7/7, `digitalmate-adapter` 83/83.

### Device (local emulator, `dm_phone`, `127.0.0.1:5555`)

Clean build of the current tree:

```
hvigor test        -> Tests run: 2310, Failure: 0, Error: 0, Pass: 2310, Ignore: 0
hvigor assembleHap -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

The HAP installs and the app launches. The startup splash shows only the pet and "DigitalMate" and
hands over to the login page — the behaviour the issue asks for on the screen reachable without an
account.

**The device guard is proven to bite.** Injecting `return 'HTTP 502 wss://private.test/ws'` for the
network kind turns exactly two tests red:

```
never lets a transport sentence reach the banner verbatim           -> Failure
shows a classified cause with no address, HTTP status or retry...   -> Failure
Tests run: 2310, Failure: 2, Error: 0, Pass: 2308
```

Restoring the source returns it to `2310 / 0 fail`.

### CI on the pushed head

`node-ut`, `hypium-ut`, `ArkTS Code Check`, `architecture-conformance`, `gate-report` and
`pr-ready` (device ST) are the required checks.

Remote tree sha equals local tree sha, so the branch content is byte-identical to what was tested.

## What this PR deliberately does NOT decide

- **The 8-second startup cap** (`A2uiHome/Index.ets:4759-4761`). The splash is force-closed after
  8s, so a slow handshake cuts to a connection screen. Whether to lengthen it, or to add a
  splash → skeleton → content state machine, is a product call and is not changed here.
- **The degradation strategy** the issue body's decision gate asks for.
- **The English-locale siblings** (#563, #564, #429, #449). Those four all rewrite connection copy in
  different files. With this table in place they should all read from it, in one follow-up, instead
  of being fixed four times.

## Measured A/B

Exact string comparison, not a screenshot: the base commit's `DigitalMateConnectionUx` and this
branch's version, loaded from their own trees and run over 32 inputs (15 transport sentences + 17
gateway strings), each through `digitalmateConnectBanner('closed', …)`.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| inputs compared | 32 | 32 |
| **leaked infrastructure** | **13** | **0** |
| wording changed | — | 23 |

"Leaked" means the rendered sentence still contained a `wss://` or `https://` address, an
`HTTP \d{3}` status, `/auth/`, `ADX`, `ECONN`, `测试凭据`, the word `Gateway`/`gateway`, a
`DigitalMate 握手…`/`DigitalMate 连接…` internal phrase, or the raw English
`Invalid credential header`.

The characteristic cases:

```
"DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"
  before: "DigitalMate 握手失败，请检查测试凭据"          <- the team talking to itself
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"Invalid credential header"
  before: "Invalid credential header"                    <- raw English, straight through
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"

"云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：鉴权入口地址、/auth/* 转发规则，以及 ADX 版本与账号路由是否已启用。"
  before: the whole 64-character operator sentence
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请重试"
```

The account panel, which used to print `snapshot.message` with no filter at all:

```
  before: "云侧鉴权接口未找到（HTTP 404）。请核对：..."
  after : "云端连接暂不可用，请稍后重试"
```

Retry ordinal, the other half of the issue:

```
attempt=1  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 1 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=3  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 3 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
attempt=9  before: "正在重新连接云端（第 9 次）…"   after: "正在连接云端…"
```

Six of the 32 inputs already rendered safely before this change, because the old regex happened to
match them - `'DigitalMate 连接异常（1006），请检查地址、网络和测试凭据'` contains `网络`, so it
became `网络不可用，请检查网络后重试`. That is the point: the old design leaked whatever did not
happen to hit a regex, and 13 of 32 did not.

### On the device

The same build, with `app_config.json` pointing at an unreachable gateway
(`wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`), renders:

```
Beebou 正在恢复云端连接…
连接较慢，仍在努力连接中…          正在连接
连接中，消息将稍后发送…
```

No address, no status code, no credential vocabulary, no retry count — in a real failure state, on
the emulator, not a unit test.

## Screenshots

HarmonyOS emulator `dm_phone` (`127.0.0.1:5555`), this branch's `assembleHap` debug build,
installed with `bm install`. The point of the change is what is **absent** from these images: no
`wss://` address, no `HTTP 404`, no `/auth/*`, no ADX version, no "测试凭据", no retry count.

**Cold start** — the splash the issue's title is about, carrying no connection detail:

![Cold start: only the pet and the product name](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/01-startup-splash.jpeg?raw=true)

**A real connection failure** — `app_config.json` (gitignored, never committed) pointed the gateway
at `wss://127.0.0.1:1/digitalmate/ws`, so the handshake could not complete:

![A real connection failure: no address, no status code, no retry count](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/02-gateway-unreachable-banner.jpeg?raw=true)

**The same failure seconds later** — the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts, which is
the "retry detail stays off the screen" half of the issue:

![The same failure later: the copy is unchanged and still counts no attempts](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/blob/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10/03-gateway-unreachable-steady.jpeg?raw=true)

The full-resolution originals and a reproduction recipe live in [`docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10`](https://github.com/qq56734/DigitalMate/tree/fix/956-connection-copy-classification/docs/developer_guide/evidence/issue-956-connection-copy-2026-11-10).

The account panel and the business-error path need a signed-in session, which needs a reachable
gateway, so no screenshot covers them; the two test suites and the A/B table above do.

Closes #956

Restores **1 E4 workflow, DM-WF-FILE-02**, and repairs the existing **DM-WF-ATTACH-01** Nightly adapter. The two cases have **2 complete passes, 0 failures and 0 blocked results** in their linked executions.

| Case | Verified behavior | Actual result and evidence |
|---|---|---|
| DM-WF-FILE-02 | Two successful writes to the same original path; exact FIRST and FINAL bytes; one artifact card; FINAL before and after background recovery. | 13 assertions and cleanup passed. [Complete Nightly run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42939739447) · [Report and screenshots](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b4abacde6c7fd993cd51ffb4cfebf22df45263b/tests/e2e/results/e4-nightly-hk/DM-WF-FILE-02/README.md) |
| DM-WF-ATTACH-01 | Switch attempt during a real 3.5 MiB upload; attachment remains in room A; removal clears the HK record; room B receives one plain control submission without an attachment. | 8 assertions and cleanup passed. The final inspection completed in one read with no retries. [Complete Nightly run](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42946573362) · [Report and screenshot](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3b4abacde6c7fd993cd51ffb4cfebf22df45263b/tests/e2e/results/e4-nightly-hk/DM-WF-ATTACH-01/README.md) |

ATTACH-01 previously required every task source reference to resolve to a visible file-source record. The backend also stores remembered message references whose records may be outside that snapshot. The reader now follows that distinction. Actual attachment records, conflicting identities and unknown missing sources remain checked. A bounded read-only retry never resends the control message; fixed diagnostic codes preserve the failing stage without exposing private errors.

FILE-02 ran on `3d64adf622c3378679a84f0fba22811bed3f0a58`; ATTACH-01 ran on `71e57c84340ecf3b7481d945459a19811d0f38c5` with the already installed App. This PR integrates the tested reader with main and limits its diagnostic-code handling to ATTACH cloud inspection. No business assertion was removed. Each result is one complete execution; repeated stability and release acceptance are not claimed.

Validation:

- Main `7facb03df6adb537e34878a0bd59235c5bd145a3` (including #1090) was merged into this branch at `5e9ba3b91ae526c6c8360b5c3cee7c73a328aa54`. The PR was subsequently merged at `852a22763b41826dd679f88ed049ed339c975fae`. node-ut, hypium-ut, architecture-conformance, ArkTS Code Check, st, gate-report and pr-ready all passed on this head. [CI](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42950189504) · [ArkTS](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42950189594) · [ST](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/42950189641).
- After integration, 190 targeted Node checks, all 30 active workflows and the daily baseline validated successfully. Both cases retain their existing execution evidence.
- Both complete GitHub Nightly workflows succeeded, including evidence publication and final reports.
- 66 targeted ATTACH and supplemental-driver checks passed on the integrated source. Counterexamples retain real attachments, reject conflicting bindings and missing file sources, and prevent error-code exposure outside ATTACH inspection.
- FILE adapter, receipt, archive, reset and workflow validation checks passed during its integration.
- Nightly YAML, shell syntax and `git diff --check` passed.

GPT-6 Astra review of the latest integration and evidence remains pending because the review quota is unavailable. Related to #565.

Adds **1 E5 E2E case**, `DM-WF-SWITCH-01`, to the HK Nightly workflow.

The case starts task A, switches to B, verifies that B completes while A is still running, checks that A’s late reply does not appear in B, and returns to A’s original reply. ## Problem  Slow DigitalMate runs cannot be reliably connected from a product reply segment to the WorkSwarm native trace, and the gateway and runtime leave important timing boundaries unobserved.  ## Changes  - Record content-free input preparation, dispatch, checkpoint, initial event wait, final stream wait, pending-history flush and stream-close spans under the WorkSwarm run. - Record bounded gateway stream milestones and explicit DigitalMate task/reply-segment-to-WorkSwarm request/session and native trace/span links. No prompt or response content is added to these correlation records. - Preserve the existing wire protocol and document the customized upstream source hashes.  Part of #1030. Related to #1031; this does not claim to fix that performance incident.  ## Verification  - `python -B -m unittest tests.server.test_workswarm_runtime_phase tests.server.test_gateway_trajectory -q` — 9 tests passed. - `python -B -m unittest test_workswarm_flow.WorkSwarmFlowTest.test_rewritten_final_segment_keeps_original_turn_correlation test_workswarm_flow.WorkSwarmFlowTest.test_phone_execution_correlates_to_the_actual_gateway_turn test_workswarm_flow.WorkSwarmFlowTest.test_phone_ask_streams_through_gateway_and_updates_health test_workswarm_adapter.WorkSwarmTest -q` with the bridge source and tests on `PYTHONPATH` — 44 tests passed, with a fake WorkSwarm gateway, including a replaced final reply and a later session turn. - `python -B harness/verify_sources.py` — passed. - On test-7, revision `6947239a` was deployed and checked against the running files. A real DigitalMate bridge request in an isolated test room linked the reply segment, task, session and request to a native trace with 17 spans, two model calls, one tool call and five gateway milestones. The final wait-for-stream-end span measured 103 ms; approximately 71 ms of this run remained outside recorded child spans. This used a sandbox-local protocol client, not the simulator. - Client-to-gateway timing remains unverified on the simulator, and recorded spans can overlap; this PR does not claim a complete end-to-end timeline. The final reply rewrite case is covered by the local fake-gateway regression test.  Tested source baseline: `13d74281`; the PR was merged with main `c69b7660` at candidate `f8f077ef`. The 9 tracing tests, 44 bridge/adapter tests and source verification passed again on that merge candidate. The real test-7 observation remains limited to the earlier `6947239a` deployment; the merged candidate has not been deployed there. Full CI and independent review are pending. An additional Windows diagnostic run of `test_workswarm_context_consumer test_dm31_a05_startup` with `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1` failed (58 failures and two setup/cleanup errors): the tests' network-denial stub blocks Windows asyncio socketpair creation; the startup suite also lacks `alembic` and its cleanup hits a Windows file lock. This diagnostic is not the required Linux isolated server receipt.  
Squashed candidate `232fbeef` has the identical source tree as `f8f077ef`; the checks above ran on the latter. CI and the independently reviewed local server receipt must be evaluated for the new candidate.

**What type of PR is this?**

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

Mask recognized Unix and Windows absolute paths in HarmonyOS assistant replies and quote previews, including history. Hold a possible path during streaming until the durable reply arrives, and replace cloud-workspace diagnostic paragraphs with a user-facing explanation; ordinary user messages, web URLs and relative paths remain unchanged.

The pet status no longer displays elapsed seconds. When the existing activity event identifies a search, read, edit or command phase, the pet identifies the corresponding tool category; unknown tools retain the generic label. No server or wire-format changes are included, and a category is not a specific MCP tool name.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #485.

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

- Source base for existing PR: main `4c7a2fdc0f8f636808326f3d9b6493885736d7cc`; original PR head `0dbdcbc3702033c6d73ecd8156dc6f012c62f74f`; tested head `c46252acf873d97d27c7235ef356981e0db37c4e`; earlier squashed head `1bca480637ef20519fe674621d24deff47b4a137` has the same Git tree as that tested head. Rebased single commit `0248da81f09ccc89a2ad569731e2f548f2496729` is based on main `c69b76608b4d5d74ddebc27bd3846ccc8b7a1d34` and includes the removed-clock test fixture fixes.
- Node v22.21.1: 157 passed, 0 failed across `digitalmate-adapter`, `digitalmate-stream-presentation`, `digitalmate-user-text`, `digitalmate-protocol-text`, `digitalmate-failure-quote-guard`, and `cloud-reply-protocol-text` unit suites. Includes path masking, streaming, tool-category and elapsed-time checks.
- HarmonyOS debug `assembleHap` succeeded; signed HAP verified with SDK `verify-app`, and installed on the connected physical device as `0.1.9-test` / 10034. The device build used the PR head plus this change (one later comment-only cleanup), the configured 20010 environment, and temporarily removed `ohos.permission.READ_WHOLE_CALENDAR` to fit its debug Profile. It is not a release package. Installation and launch were verified; the actual pet-status transitions and path masking have not yet been validated on the device.
- Clock-removal fixture regression: 102/102 targeted tests passed. Local full suite: 2,870 passed / 4 failed / 9 skipped; the four local failures (missing Chromium and local OpenSSL configuration) passed separately using installed Edge and an isolated OpenSSL config (11/11). These local runs do not replace CI.
- Rebased source: local full Node suite 2,874 passed / 0 failed / 9 skipped using installed Edge via a Playwright preload and isolated OpenSSL configuration. Local architecture scan checked 42 of 287 files with no findings, using the unchanged main policy. CI remains authoritative and is pending.
- `git diff --check` passed for the update. CI, Hypium, live cloud end-to-end and platform full-calendar permission verification have not been run or verified.

Path masking is client-side presentation, not server-side sanitization; stored records and other clients can still contain paths. The regular expression covers common unquoted paths rather than every OS path syntax, and path-like technical text may be hidden. Streaming after a candidate path is delayed until the durable response.
